easypaperless.resources

Resource Classes

The following resource classes are _internal classes. Methods can be accessed via the instance of easypaperless.PaperlessClient or easypaperless.SyncPaperlessClient

Example:

async with PaperlessClient(url="http://localhost:8000", api_token="abc") as client: docs = await client.documents.list(max_results=10)

class CorrespondentsResource: 
 21class CorrespondentsResource:
 22    """Accessor for correspondents: ``client.correspondents``."""
 23
 24    def __init__(self, core: _ClientCore) -> None:
 25        self._core = core
 26
 27    async def list(
 28        self,
 29        *,
 30        ids: List[int] | None = None,
 31        name_contains: str | None = None,
 32        name_exact: str | None = None,
 33        page: int | None = None,
 34        page_size: int | None = None,
 35        ordering: str | None = None,
 36        descending: bool = False,
 37    ) -> PagedResult[Correspondent]:
 38        """Return correspondents defined in paperless-ngx.
 39
 40        When ``page`` is ``None`` (the default), all pages are fetched
 41        automatically and ``next`` / ``previous`` in the result are always
 42        ``None``.  When ``page`` is set, only that page is fetched and
 43        ``next`` / ``previous`` reflect the raw API values.
 44
 45        Args:
 46            ids: Return only correspondents whose ID is in this list.
 47            name_contains: Case-insensitive substring filter on name.
 48            name_exact: Case-insensitive exact match on name.
 49            page: Return only this specific page (1-based).
 50            page_size: Number of results per page.
 51            ordering: Field to sort by.
 52            descending: When ``True``, reverses the sort direction.
 53
 54        Returns:
 55            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
 56            :class:`~easypaperless.models.correspondents.Correspondent` objects.
 57        """
 58        logger.info("Listing correspondents")
 59        params: dict[str, Any] = {}
 60        if ids is not None:
 61            params["id__in"] = ",".join(str(i) for i in ids)
 62        if name_contains is not None:
 63            params["name__icontains"] = name_contains
 64        if name_exact is not None:
 65            params["name__iexact"] = name_exact
 66        if page is not None:
 67            params["page"] = page
 68        if page_size is not None:
 69            params["page_size"] = page_size
 70        if ordering is not None:
 71            params["ordering"] = f"-{ordering}" if descending else ordering
 72        return cast(
 73            PagedResult[Correspondent],
 74            await self._core._list_resource("correspondents", Correspondent, params or None),
 75        )
 76
 77    async def get(self, id: int) -> Correspondent:
 78        """Fetch a single correspondent by its ID.
 79
 80        Args:
 81            id: Numeric correspondent ID.
 82
 83        Returns:
 84            The :class:`~easypaperless.models.correspondents.Correspondent` with the given ID.
 85
 86        Raises:
 87            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no correspondent exists with that ID.
 88        """
 89        logger.info("Getting correspondent id=%d", id)
 90        return cast(
 91            Correspondent, await self._core._get_resource("correspondents", id, Correspondent)
 92        )
 93
 94    async def create(
 95        self,
 96        *,
 97        name: str,
 98        match: str | Unset = UNSET,
 99        matching_algorithm: MatchingAlgorithm | Unset = UNSET,
100        is_insensitive: bool = True,
101        owner: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
102        set_permissions: SetPermissions | None | Unset = UNSET,
103    ) -> Correspondent:
104        """Create a new correspondent.
105
106        Args:
107            name: Correspondent name. Must be unique.
108            match: Auto-matching pattern.
109            matching_algorithm: Controls how ``match`` is applied.
110                E.g. ``matching_algorithm=MatchingAlgorithm.REGEX`` for
111                regular-expression matching.
112            is_insensitive: When ``True``, ``match`` is case-insensitive.
113                Defaults to ``True``, matching the paperless-ngx API default.
114            owner: Numeric user ID to assign as owner.
115            set_permissions: Explicit view/change permission sets.
116                Pass ``None`` to create with empty permissions.
117
118        Returns:
119            The newly created :class:`~easypaperless.models.correspondents.Correspondent`.
120        """
121        logger.info("Creating correspondent name=%r", name)
122        return cast(
123            Correspondent,
124            await self._core._create_resource(
125                "correspondents",
126                Correspondent,
127                owner=owner,
128                set_permissions=set_permissions,
129                name=name,
130                match=match,
131                matching_algorithm=matching_algorithm,
132                is_insensitive=is_insensitive,
133            ),
134        )
135
136    async def update(
137        self,
138        id: int,
139        *,
140        name: str | Unset = UNSET,
141        match: str | Unset = UNSET,
142        matching_algorithm: MatchingAlgorithm | Unset = UNSET,
143        is_insensitive: bool | Unset = UNSET,
144        owner: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
145        set_permissions: SetPermissions | None | Unset = UNSET,
146    ) -> Correspondent:
147        """Partially update a correspondent (PATCH semantics).
148
149        Args:
150            id: Numeric ID of the correspondent to update.
151            name: Correspondent name.
152            match: Auto-matching pattern.
153            matching_algorithm: Controls how ``match`` is applied.
154                E.g. ``matching_algorithm=MatchingAlgorithm.REGEX`` for
155                regular-expression matching.
156            is_insensitive: When ``True``, ``match`` is case-insensitive.
157            owner: Numeric user ID to assign as owner.
158                Pass ``None`` to clear the owner.
159                Omit (or pass :data:`~easypaperless.UNSET`) to leave unchanged.
160            set_permissions: Explicit view/change permission sets.
161                Pass ``None`` to clear all permissions (overwrite with empty).
162                Omit (or pass :data:`~easypaperless.UNSET`) to leave unchanged.
163
164        Returns:
165            The updated :class:`~easypaperless.models.correspondents.Correspondent`.
166        """
167        logger.info("Updating correspondent id=%d", id)
168        return cast(
169            Correspondent,
170            await self._core._update_resource(
171                "correspondents",
172                id,
173                Correspondent,
174                name=name,
175                match=match,
176                matching_algorithm=matching_algorithm,
177                is_insensitive=is_insensitive,
178                owner=owner,
179                set_permissions=set_permissions,
180            ),
181        )
182
183    async def delete(self, id: int) -> None:
184        """Delete a correspondent.
185
186        Args:
187            id: Numeric ID of the correspondent to delete.
188
189        Raises:
190            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no correspondent exists with that ID.
191        """
192        logger.info("Deleting correspondent id=%d", id)
193        await self._core._delete_resource("correspondents", id)
194
195    async def bulk_delete(self, ids: List[int]) -> None:
196        """Permanently delete multiple correspondents in a single request.
197
198        Args:
199            ids: List of correspondent IDs to delete.
200        """
201        logger.info("Bulk deleting %d correspondents", len(ids))
202        await self._core._bulk_edit_objects("correspondents", ids, "delete")
203
204    async def bulk_set_permissions(
205        self,
206        ids: List[int],
207        *,
208        set_permissions: SetPermissions | Unset = UNSET,
209        owner: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
210        merge: bool = False,
211    ) -> None:
212        """Set permissions and/or owner on multiple correspondents.
213
214        Args:
215            ids: List of correspondent IDs to modify.
216            set_permissions: Explicit view/change permission sets.
217                Omit (or pass :data:`~easypaperless.UNSET`) to leave unchanged.
218            owner: Numeric user ID to assign as owner.
219                Pass ``None`` to clear the owner.
220                Omit (or pass :data:`~easypaperless.UNSET`) to leave unchanged.
221            merge: When ``True``, new permissions are merged with existing ones.
222        """
223        logger.info("Bulk setting permissions on %d correspondents", len(ids))
224        params: dict[str, Any] = {"merge": merge}
225        if not isinstance(set_permissions, Unset):
226            params["permissions"] = set_permissions.model_dump()
227        if not isinstance(owner, Unset):
228            params["owner"] = owner
229        await self._core._bulk_edit_objects("correspondents", ids, "set_permissions", **params)

208        set_permissions: SetPermissions | Unset = UNSET,
209        owner: int | None | Unset = UNSET,

213
214        Args:

216            set_permissions: Explicit view/change permission sets.

225        if not isinstance(set_permissions, Unset):
226            params["permissions"] = set_permissions.model_dump()

228            params["owner"] = owner
229        await self._core._bulk_edit_objects("document_types", ids, "set_permissions", **params)

  71    async def history(
  72        self,
  73        document_id: int,
  74        *,
  75        page: int | None = None,
  76        page_size: int | None = None,
  77    ) -> PagedResult[AuditLogEntry]:
  78        """Fetch the audit log for a document.
  79
  80        The paperless-ngx ``/api/documents/{id}/history/`` endpoint returns a
  81        plain JSON array rather than a paginated envelope.  This method wraps
  82        the response into a :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult`
  83        so callers always receive a consistent return type.
  84
  85        Args:
  86            document_id: Numeric ID of the document whose history to retrieve.
  87            page: Forwarded to the API as a query parameter when provided.
  88                Effect depends on the paperless-ngx version; the server may
  89                ignore this parameter.
  90            page_size: Forwarded to the API as a query parameter when provided.
  91
  92        Returns:
  93            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
  94            :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.AuditLogEntry` objects,
  95            ordered by timestamp descending.
  96
  97        Raises:
  98            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
  99                with that ID.
 100        """
 101        logger.info("Fetching history for document id=%d", document_id)
 102        path = f"/documents/{document_id}/history/"
 103        params: dict[str, Any] = {}
 104        if page is not None:
 105            params["page"] = page
 106        if page_size is not None:
 107            params["page_size"] = page_size
 108
 109        resp = await self._core._session.get(path, params=params or None)
 110        data = resp.json()
 111
 112        if isinstance(data, list):
 113            entries = [AuditLogEntry.model_validate(item) for item in data]
 114            entry_ids: list[int] = [e.id for e in entries]
 115            return PagedResult(
 116                count=len(entries),
 117                next=None,
 118                previous=None,
 119                all=entry_ids if entry_ids else None,
 120                results=entries,
 121            )
 122
 123        # Forward-compatible: handle a paginated envelope if the API ever adds one.
 124        items: list[Any] = list(data.get("results", []))
 125        count: int = data.get("count", 0)
 126        all_ids: list[int] | None = data.get("all")
 127        return PagedResult(
 128            count=count,
 129            next=data.get("next"),
 130            previous=data.get("previous"),
 131            all=all_ids,
 132            results=[AuditLogEntry.model_validate(item) for item in items],
 133        )

 135    @staticmethod
 136    def _format_date_value(value: date | datetime | str) -> str:
 137        if isinstance(value, datetime):
 138            return value.isoformat()
 139        if isinstance(value, date):
 140            return value.isoformat()
 141        return value
 142
 143    @staticmethod
 144    def _is_datetime(value: date | datetime | str) -> bool:
 145        if isinstance(value, datetime):
 146            return True
 147        if isinstance(value, str):
 148            return bool(_DATETIME_STR_RE.match(value))
 149        return False

 151    async def get(self, id: int, *, include_metadata: bool = False) -> Document:
 152        """Fetch a single document by its ID.
 153
 154        Args:
 155            id: Numeric paperless-ngx document ID.
 156            include_metadata: When ``True``, the extended file-level metadata
 157                is fetched concurrently and attached to the document.
 158                Default: ``False``.
 159
 160        Returns:
 161            The :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document` with the
 162            given ID.
 163
 164        Raises:
 165            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
 166                with that ID.
 167        """
 168        logger.info("Getting document id=%d", id)
 169        if include_metadata:
 170            doc_resp, meta_resp = await asyncio.gather(
 171                self._core._session.get(f"/documents/{id}/"),
 172                self._core._session.get(f"/documents/{id}/metadata/"),
 173            )
 174            data = doc_resp.json()
 175            data["metadata"] = meta_resp.json()
 176        else:
 177            resp = await self._core._session.get(f"/documents/{id}/")
 178            data = resp.json()
 179        return Document.model_validate(data)

 244    ) -> PagedResult[Document]:
 245        """Return a filtered list of documents.
 246
 247        All tag, correspondent, document-type, storage-path, and custom-field
 248        parameters accept either integer IDs or string names.
 249
 250        When ``page`` is ``None`` (the default), all pages are fetched
 251        automatically and ``next`` / ``previous`` in the returned
 252        :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` are always
 253        ``None`` — even if ``max_results`` truncates the final result set.
 254        ``count`` always reflects the server total, not the truncated length.
 255        When ``page`` is set to a specific integer, only that one page is
 256        fetched and ``next`` / ``previous`` contain the raw API values.
 257
 258        Args:
 259            search: Search string.  Behaviour depends on ``search_mode``.
 260            search_mode: How ``search`` is applied.  One of:
 261                ``"title_or_content"`` *(default)*, ``"title"``, ``"query"``,
 262                ``"original_filename"``.
 263            ids: Return only documents whose ID is in this list.
 264            tags: Documents must have **all** of these tags (AND semantics).
 265            any_tags: Documents must have **at least one** of these tags.
 266            exclude_tags: Documents must have **none** of these tags.
 267            correspondent: Filter to documents assigned to this correspondent.
 268                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no correspondent set.
 269            any_correspondent: Filter to documents assigned to any of these.
 270            exclude_correspondents: Exclude documents assigned to any of these.
 271            document_type: Filter to documents of exactly this type.
 272                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no document type set.
 273            document_type_name_contains: Case-insensitive substring filter on document type name.
 274            document_type_name_exact: Case-insensitive exact match on document type name.
 275            any_document_type: Filter to documents whose type is any of these.
 276            exclude_document_types: Exclude documents whose type is any of these.
 277            storage_path: Filter to documents assigned to this storage path.
 278                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no storage path set.
 279            any_storage_paths: Filter to documents assigned to any of these paths.
 280            exclude_storage_paths: Exclude documents assigned to any of these paths.
 281            owner: Filter to documents owned by this user ID.
 282                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no owner set.
 283            exclude_owners: Exclude documents owned by any of these user IDs.
 284            custom_fields: Documents must have **all** of these custom fields set.
 285            any_custom_fields: Documents must have **at least one** of these fields.
 286            exclude_custom_fields: Documents must have **none** of these fields.
 287            custom_field_query: Filter documents by custom field values using a nested
 288                query structure. See the `paperless-ngx API docs
 289                <https://docs.paperless-ngx.com/api/#filtering-by-custom-fields>`_ for
 290                the query format.
 291            archive_serial_number: Filter by exact archive serial number.
 292                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no ASN set.
 293            archive_serial_number_from: Filter by ASN >= this value.
 294            archive_serial_number_till: Filter by ASN <= this value.
 295            created_after: Only documents created after this date.
 296                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"``.
 297            created_before: Only documents created before this date.
 298                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"``.
 299            added_after: Only documents added after this date/time.
 300                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` for date precision or
 301                ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"`` for datetime precision.
 302            added_from: Only documents added on or after this date/time.
 303                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
 304            added_before: Only documents added before this date/time.
 305                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
 306            added_until: Only documents added on or before this date/time.
 307                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
 308            modified_after: Only documents modified after this date/time.
 309                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
 310            modified_from: Only documents modified on or after this date/time.
 311                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
 312            modified_before: Only documents modified before this date/time.
 313                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
 314            modified_until: Only documents modified on or before this date/time.
 315                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
 316            checksum: MD5 checksum (hex) of the original uploaded file, matched
 317                exactly but case-insensitively (sent as ``checksum__iexact``).
 318                Documents in the trash are **not** found, yet paperless-ngx
 319                still rejects a re-upload of the same file as a duplicate.  To
 320                detect that case, catch the
 321                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError` of
 322                ``upload(wait=True)`` (or of ``tasks.wait()``): ``err.task.result``
 323                contains ``": It is a duplicate of "`` and ends in
 324                ``"Note: existing document is in the trash."``, and
 325                ``err.task.related_document`` is ``None`` (for a live duplicate
 326                it is the existing document's ID).  ``client.trash.list()``
 327                shows the trashed document; ``client.trash.restore()`` brings
 328                it back.

 330            page: Return only this specific page (1-based).
 331            ordering: Field name to sort by.
 332            descending: When ``True``, reverses the sort direction.
 333            max_results: Stop after collecting this many documents.
 334            on_page: Callback invoked after each page fetch.

 337            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
 338            :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document` objects.
 339        """
 340        logger.info("Listing documents")
 341        resolver = self._core._resolver
 342        params: dict[str, Any] = {"page_size": page_size}
 343
 344        if search is not None:
 345            api_param = _SEARCH_MODE_MAP.get(search_mode, "search")
 346            params[api_param] = search
 347
 348        if ids is not None:
 349            params["id__in"] = ",".join(str(i) for i in ids)
 350
 351        if tags is not None:
 352            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", tags)
 353            params["tags__id__all"] = ",".join(str(t) for t in resolved)
 354
 355        if any_tags is not None:
 356            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", any_tags)
 357            params["tags__id__in"] = ",".join(str(t) for t in resolved)
 358
 359        if exclude_tags is not None:
 360            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", exclude_tags)
 361            params["tags__id__none"] = ",".join(str(t) for t in resolved)
 362
 363        if any_correspondent is not None:
 364            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("correspondents", any_correspondent)
 365            params["correspondent__id__in"] = ",".join(str(c) for c in resolved)
 366        elif not isinstance(correspondent, Unset):
 367            if correspondent is None:
 368                params["correspondent__isnull"] = "true"
 369            else:
 370                resolved_id = await resolver.resolve("correspondents", correspondent)
 371                params["correspondent__id"] = resolved_id
 372
 373        if exclude_correspondents is not None:
 374            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("correspondents", exclude_correspondents)
 375            params["correspondent__id__none"] = ",".join(str(c) for c in resolved)
 376
 377        if document_type_name_contains is not None:
 378            params["document_type__name__icontains"] = document_type_name_contains
 379        if document_type_name_exact is not None:
 380            params["document_type__name__iexact"] = document_type_name_exact
 381
 382        if any_document_type is not None:
 383            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("document_types", any_document_type)
 384            params["document_type__id__in"] = ",".join(str(d) for d in resolved)
 385        elif not isinstance(document_type, Unset):
 386            if document_type is None:
 387                params["document_type__isnull"] = "true"
 388            else:
 389                resolved_id = await resolver.resolve("document_types", document_type)
 390                params["document_type__id"] = resolved_id
 391
 392        if exclude_document_types is not None:
 393            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("document_types", exclude_document_types)
 394            params["document_type__id__none"] = ",".join(str(d) for d in resolved)
 395
 396        if any_storage_paths is not None:
 397            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("storage_paths", any_storage_paths)
 398            params["storage_path__id__in"] = ",".join(str(s) for s in resolved)
 399        elif not isinstance(storage_path, Unset):
 400            if storage_path is None:
 401                params["storage_path__isnull"] = "true"
 402            else:
 403                resolved_id = await resolver.resolve("storage_paths", storage_path)
 404                params["storage_path__id"] = resolved_id
 405
 406        if exclude_storage_paths is not None:
 407            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("storage_paths", exclude_storage_paths)
 408            params["storage_path__id__none"] = ",".join(str(s) for s in resolved)
 409
 410        if not isinstance(owner, Unset):
 411            if owner is None:
 412                params["owner__isnull"] = "true"
 413            else:
 414                params["owner__id"] = owner
 415
 416        if exclude_owners is not None:
 417            params["owner__id__none"] = ",".join(str(o) for o in exclude_owners)
 418
 419        if custom_fields is not None:
 420            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("custom_fields", custom_fields)
 421            params["custom_fields__id__all"] = ",".join(str(f) for f in resolved)
 422
 423        if any_custom_fields is not None:
 424            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("custom_fields", any_custom_fields)
 425            params["custom_fields__id__in"] = ",".join(str(f) for f in resolved)
 426
 427        if exclude_custom_fields is not None:
 428            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("custom_fields", exclude_custom_fields)
 429            params["custom_fields__id__none"] = ",".join(str(f) for f in resolved)
 430
 431        if custom_field_query is not None:
 432            params["custom_field_query"] = json.dumps(custom_field_query)
 433
 434        if not isinstance(archive_serial_number, Unset):
 435            if archive_serial_number is None:
 436                params["archive_serial_number__isnull"] = "true"
 437            else:
 438                params["archive_serial_number"] = archive_serial_number
 439
 440        if archive_serial_number_from is not None:
 441            params["archive_serial_number__gte"] = archive_serial_number_from
 442
 443        if archive_serial_number_till is not None:
 444            params["archive_serial_number__lte"] = archive_serial_number_till
 445
 446        if created_after is not None:
 447            params["created__date__gt"] = self._format_date_value(created_after)
 448
 449        if created_before is not None:
 450            params["created__date__lt"] = self._format_date_value(created_before)
 451
 452        if added_after is not None:
 453            key = "added__gt" if self._is_datetime(added_after) else "added__date__gt"
 454            params[key] = self._format_date_value(added_after)
 455
 456        if added_from is not None:
 457            key = "added__gte" if self._is_datetime(added_from) else "added__date__gte"
 458            params[key] = self._format_date_value(added_from)
 459
 460        if added_before is not None:
 461            key = "added__lt" if self._is_datetime(added_before) else "added__date__lt"
 462            params[key] = self._format_date_value(added_before)
 463
 464        if added_until is not None:
 465            key = "added__lte" if self._is_datetime(added_until) else "added__date__lte"
 466            params[key] = self._format_date_value(added_until)
 467
 468        if modified_after is not None:
 469            key = "modified__gt" if self._is_datetime(modified_after) else "modified__date__gt"
 470            params[key] = self._format_date_value(modified_after)
 471
 472        if modified_from is not None:
 473            key = "modified__gte" if self._is_datetime(modified_from) else "modified__date__gte"
 474            params[key] = self._format_date_value(modified_from)
 475
 476        if modified_before is not None:
 477            key = "modified__lt" if self._is_datetime(modified_before) else "modified__date__lt"
 478            params[key] = self._format_date_value(modified_before)
 479
 480        if modified_until is not None:
 481            key = "modified__lte" if self._is_datetime(modified_until) else "modified__date__lte"
 482            params[key] = self._format_date_value(modified_until)
 483
 484        if checksum is not None:
 485            params["checksum__iexact"] = checksum
 486
 487        if ordering is not None:
 488            params["ordering"] = f"-{ordering}" if descending else ordering
 489
 490        if page is not None:
 491            params["page"] = page
 492            raw = await self._core._session.get_page("/documents/", params=params)
 493            items = raw.items
 494            if max_results is not None:
 495                items = items[:max_results]
 496            return PagedResult(
 497                count=raw.count,
 498                next=raw.next,
 499                previous=raw.previous,
 500                all=raw.all_ids,
 501                results=[Document.model_validate(item) for item in items],
 502            )
 503
 504        raw = await self._core._session.get_all_pages_paged(
 505            "/documents/", params, max_results=max_results, on_page=on_page
 506        )
 507        return PagedResult(
 508            count=raw.count,
 509            next=raw.next,
 510            previous=raw.previous,
 511            all=raw.all_ids,
 512            results=[Document.model_validate(item) for item in raw.items],
 513        )
 514
 515    async def update(
 516        self,
 517        id: int,
 518        *,
 519        title: str | Unset = UNSET,
 520        content: str | Unset = UNSET,
 521        created: date | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
 522        correspondent: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
 523        document_type: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
 524        storage_path: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
 525        tags: List[int | str] | None | Unset = UNSET,
 526        archive_serial_number: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
 527        custom_fields: List[dict[str, Any]] | None | Unset = UNSET,
 528        owner: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
 529        set_permissions: SetPermissions | None | Unset = UNSET,
 530        remove_inbox_tags: bool | None | Unset = UNSET,
 531    ) -> Document:
 532        """Partially update a document (PATCH semantics).
 533
 534        Args:
 535            id: Numeric ID of the document to update.
 536            title: New document title.
 537            content: OCR text content of the document.
 538            created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string (``"YYYY-MM-DD"``) or a
 539                :class:`~datetime.date` object.
 540            correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
 541                Pass ``None`` to clear the correspondent.
 542            document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
 543                Pass ``None`` to clear the document type.
 544            storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
 545                Pass ``None`` to clear the storage path.
 546            tags: Full replacement list of tags (IDs or names).
 547            archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
 548                Pass ``None`` to clear the archive serial number.
 549            custom_fields: List of ``{"field": <field_id>, "value": ...}`` dicts.
 550            owner: Numeric user ID to assign as document owner.
 551                Pass ``None`` to clear the owner.
 552            set_permissions: Explicit view/change permission sets.
 553                Pass ``None`` to clear all permissions (overwrite with empty).
 554                Omit (or pass :data:`~easypaperless.UNSET`) to leave unchanged.
 555                The given sets replace the document's current view and change
 556                users and groups.  Together with ``owner`` everything goes out
 557                in one PATCH, which paperless-ngx applies as a whole.
 558            remove_inbox_tags: When ``True``, removes all inbox tags from the document.
 559
 560        Returns:
 561            The updated :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document`.
 562        """
 563        logger.info("Updating document id=%d", id)
 564        resolver = self._core._resolver
 565        payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
 566
 567        if not isinstance(title, Unset):
 568            payload["title"] = title
 569        if not isinstance(content, Unset):
 570            payload["content"] = content
 571        if not isinstance(created, Unset):
 572            payload["created"] = self._format_date_value(created) if created is not None else None
 573        if not isinstance(correspondent, Unset):
 574            payload["correspondent"] = (
 575                None
 576                if correspondent is None
 577                else await resolver.resolve("correspondents", correspondent)
 578            )
 579        if not isinstance(document_type, Unset):
 580            payload["document_type"] = (
 581                None
 582                if document_type is None
 583                else await resolver.resolve("document_types", document_type)
 584            )
 585        if not isinstance(storage_path, Unset):
 586            payload["storage_path"] = (
 587                None
 588                if storage_path is None
 589                else await resolver.resolve("storage_paths", storage_path)
 590            )
 591        if not isinstance(tags, Unset):
 592            payload["tags"] = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", tags or [])
 593        if not isinstance(archive_serial_number, Unset):
 594            payload["archive_serial_number"] = archive_serial_number
 595        if not isinstance(custom_fields, Unset):
 596            payload["custom_fields"] = custom_fields
 597        if not isinstance(owner, Unset):
 598            payload["owner"] = owner
 599        if not isinstance(set_permissions, Unset):
 600            payload["set_permissions"] = (
 601                SetPermissions().model_dump()
 602                if set_permissions is None
 603                else set_permissions.model_dump()
 604            )
 605        if not isinstance(remove_inbox_tags, Unset):
 606            payload["remove_inbox_tags"] = remove_inbox_tags
 607
 608        resp = await self._core._session.patch(f"/documents/{id}/", json=payload)
 609        return Document.model_validate(resp.json())
 610
 611    async def delete(self, id: int) -> None:
 612        """Permanently delete a document.
 613
 614        Args:
 615            id: Numeric ID of the document to delete.
 616
 617        Raises:
 618            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
 619                with that ID.
 620        """
 621        logger.info("Deleting document id=%d", id)
 622        await self._core._session.delete(f"/documents/{id}/")

 624    async def download(self, id: int, *, original: bool = False) -> bytes:
 625        """Download the binary content of a document.
 626
 627        Args:
 628            id: Numeric ID of the document to download.
 629            original: If ``False`` *(default)*, returns the archived PDF
 630                (``GET /documents/{id}/download/``).
 631                If ``True``, returns the original uploaded file
 632                (``GET /documents/{id}/download/?original=true``).
 633
 634        Returns:
 635            Raw file bytes.
 636        """
 637        logger.info("Downloading document id=%d (original=%s)", id, original)
 638        path = f"/documents/{id}/download/"
 639        if original:
 640            path += "?original=true"
 641        resp = await self._core._session.get_download(path)
 642        return _binary_content(resp, "Download")

 644    async def thumbnail(self, id: int) -> bytes:
 645        """Fetch the thumbnail image of a document.
 646
 647        Args:
 648            id: Numeric ID of the document whose thumbnail to retrieve.
 649
 650        Returns:
 651            Raw binary content of the thumbnail image.
 652
 653        Raises:
 654            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
 655                with that ID.
 656            ~easypaperless.exceptions.ServerResponseError: If the server returns an
 657                HTML page (e.g. an auth redirect) instead of the image.
 658        """
 659        logger.info("Fetching thumbnail for document id=%d", id)
 660        resp = await self._core._session.get_download(f"/documents/{id}/thumb/")
 661        return _binary_content(resp, "Thumbnail")

 663    async def upload(
 664        self,
 665        file: str | Path | bytes,
 666        *,
 667        filename: str | None = None,
 668        content_type: str | None = None,
 669        request_timeout: float | None = None,
 670        title: str | Unset = UNSET,
 671        created: date | str | None = None,
 672        correspondent: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
 673        document_type: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
 674        storage_path: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
 675        tags: List[int | str] | None = None,
 676        archive_serial_number: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
 677        custom_fields: List[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
 678        wait: bool = False,
 679        poll_interval: float | None = None,
 680        poll_timeout: float | None = None,
 681    ) -> str | Document:
 682        """Upload a document to paperless-ngx.
 683
 684        The upload request is never retried automatically, whatever the
 685        client's ``retry_attempts`` / ``tenacity_retrying`` settings: if the
 686        connection fails after paperless-ngx has accepted the file, a retry
 687        would create a duplicate.  A failed upload raises (e.g.
 688        :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TransportTimeoutError`) so you can
 689        decide whether to check for the document and upload again.
 690
 691        Args:
 692            file: Path to the file to upload (``str`` or :class:`~pathlib.Path`),
 693                or the file content as ``bytes``.  Bytes are sent directly; no
 694                temporary file is written.
 695            filename: File name sent to paperless-ngx.  Required when *file* is
 696                ``bytes`` (omitting it raises
 697                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError` before any
 698                request).  For a path, overrides the name taken from the path.
 699            content_type: MIME type of the file part, sent as given (e.g.
 700                ``"application/pdf"``).  When omitted, it is guessed from the
 701                file name as before.  paperless-ngx detects the file type from
 702                the bytes and does not rely on this value to accept the file.
 703            request_timeout: HTTP timeout in seconds for the upload request
 704                only, overriding the client's ``timeout`` for this call.  Does
 705                not affect task polling (see ``poll_timeout``).  When omitted,
 706                the client's ``timeout`` applies.
 707            title: Title to assign to the document.
 708            created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string (``"YYYY-MM-DD"``) or a
 709                :class:`~datetime.date` object.
 710            correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
 711            document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
 712            storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
 713            tags: Tags to assign, as IDs or names.
 714            archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
 715            custom_fields: List of ``{"field": <field_id>, "value": ...}`` dicts.
 716            wait: If ``False`` *(default)*, returns immediately with the task ID.
 717                If ``True``, polls until processing completes.
 718            poll_interval: Seconds between task-status checks while waiting for
 719                processing to complete (requires ``wait=True``). Overrides the
 720                client-level default. When omitted, falls back to the client-level
 721                ``poll_interval`` (``2.0`` s unless changed at construction).
 722            poll_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait before raising
 723                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError` (requires
 724                ``wait=True``). Overrides the client-level default. When omitted,
 725                falls back to the client-level ``poll_timeout`` (``60.0`` s unless
 726                changed at construction).
 727
 728        Returns:
 729            The Celery task ID string when ``wait=False``, or the fully
 730            processed :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document`
 731            when ``wait=True``.
 732
 733        Raises:
 734            ~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError: If *file* is ``bytes``
 735                and no *filename* is given.
 736            ~easypaperless.exceptions.BadRequestError: If paperless-ngx rejects
 737                the file before processing starts, e.g. an unsupported file
 738                type or an empty file (``err.field_errors["document"]``).
 739            ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError: If processing fails;
 740                ``err.task`` holds the task with paperless-ngx's ``result``
 741                unaltered.  For a duplicate, ``err.task.result`` contains
 742                ``": It is a duplicate of "`` and ``err.task.related_document``
 743                is the existing document's ID (``None`` if that document is
 744                in the trash).
 745            ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError: If timeout is exceeded;
 746                resume with ``client.tasks.wait(err.task_id)``.
 747        """
 748        resolver = self._core._resolver
 749        if isinstance(file, bytes):
 750            if not filename:
 751                raise ValidationError("filename is required when uploading from bytes")
 752            file_bytes = file
 753            upload_name = filename
 754        else:
 755            file_path = Path(file)
 756            file_bytes = file_path.read_bytes()
 757            upload_name = filename if filename is not None else file_path.name
 758        logger.info("Uploading %r (%d bytes)", upload_name, len(file_bytes))
 759
 760        data: dict[str, Any] = {}
 761        if not isinstance(title, Unset):
 762            data["title"] = title
 763        if created is not None:
 764            data["created"] = self._format_date_value(created)
 765        if not isinstance(correspondent, Unset) and correspondent is not None:
 766            data["correspondent"] = await resolver.resolve("correspondents", correspondent)
 767        if not isinstance(document_type, Unset) and document_type is not None:
 768            data["document_type"] = await resolver.resolve("document_types", document_type)
 769        if not isinstance(storage_path, Unset) and storage_path is not None:
 770            data["storage_path"] = await resolver.resolve("storage_paths", storage_path)
 771        if tags is not None:
 772            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", tags)
 773            data["tags"] = resolved
 774        if not isinstance(archive_serial_number, Unset) and archive_serial_number is not None:
 775            data["archive_serial_number"] = archive_serial_number
 776        if custom_fields is not None:
 777            data["custom_fields"] = json.dumps(custom_fields)
 778
 779        # Without content_type httpx derives it from the file name (previous behaviour).
 780        document_part: tuple[str, bytes] | tuple[str, bytes, str] = (
 781            (upload_name, file_bytes)
 782            if content_type is None
 783            else (upload_name, file_bytes, content_type)
 784        )
 785        files = {"document": document_part}
 786        resp = await self._core._session.post(
 787            "/documents/post_document/",
 788            data=data,
 789            files=files,
 790            timeout=request_timeout,
 791            retry=False,  # a retry after a lost response would upload a duplicate
 792        )
 793        task_id: str = resp.text.strip('"')
 794        logger.debug("Upload accepted, task_id=%r", task_id)
 795
 796        if not wait:
 797            return task_id
 798
 799        task = await self._core.tasks.wait(
 800            task_id, poll_interval=poll_interval, poll_timeout=poll_timeout
 801        )
 802        if task.related_document is None:
 803            raise UploadError(f"Task {task_id!r} succeeded but returned no document ID", task=task)
 804        doc_id = int(task.related_document)
 805        logger.info("Task %r produced document_id=%d", task_id, doc_id)
 806        return await self.get(doc_id)
 807

 812    async def _bulk_edit(self, document_ids: List[int], method: str, **parameters: Any) -> None:
 813        """Execute a bulk-edit operation on a list of documents.
 814
 815        Args:
 816            document_ids: List of document IDs to operate on.
 817            method: Bulk-edit method name (e.g. ``"add_tag"``, ``"delete"``).
 818            **parameters: Additional keyword arguments forwarded to the API.
 819        """
 820        payload = {"documents": document_ids, "method": method, "parameters": parameters}
 821        await self._core._session.post("/documents/bulk_edit/", json=payload, timeout=120.0)
 822
 823    async def bulk_add_tag(self, document_ids: List[int], tag: int | str) -> None:
 824        """Add a tag to multiple documents in a single request.
 825
 826        Args:
 827            document_ids: List of document IDs to tag.
 828            tag: Tag to add, as an ID or name.
 829        """
 830        logger.info("Bulk adding tag %r to %d documents", tag, len(document_ids))
 831        tag_id = await self._core._resolver.resolve("tags", tag)
 832        await self._bulk_edit(document_ids, "add_tag", tag=tag_id)

 834    async def bulk_remove_tag(self, document_ids: List[int], tag: int | str) -> None:
 835        """Remove a tag from multiple documents in a single request.

 837        Args:

 839            tag: Tag to remove, as an ID or name.
 840        """
 841        logger.info("Bulk removing tag %r from %d documents", tag, len(document_ids))
 842        tag_id = await self._core._resolver.resolve("tags", tag)
 843        await self._bulk_edit(document_ids, "remove_tag", tag=tag_id)

 845    async def bulk_modify_tags(

 850        remove_tags: List[int | str] | None = None,

 854        Args:

 857            remove_tags: Tags to remove, as IDs or names.

 865    async def bulk_delete(self, document_ids: List[int]) -> None:

 874    async def bulk_set_correspondent(
 875        self, document_ids: List[int], correspondent: int | str | None
 876    ) -> None:
 877        """Assign a correspondent to multiple documents in a single request.
 878
 879        Args:
 880            document_ids: List of document IDs to modify.
 881            correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
 882                Pass ``None`` to clear.
 883        """
 884        logger.info(
 885            "Bulk setting correspondent %r on %d documents", correspondent, len(document_ids)
 886        )
 887        cor_id: int | None = None
 888        if correspondent is not None:

async def history( self, document_id: int, *, page: int | None = None, page_size: int | None = None) -> easypaperless.PagedResult[AuditLogEntry]: 
 71    async def history(
 72        self,
 73        document_id: int,
 74        *,
 75        page: int | None = None,
 76        page_size: int | None = None,
 77    ) -> PagedResult[AuditLogEntry]:
 78        """Fetch the audit log for a document.
 79
 80        The paperless-ngx ``/api/documents/{id}/history/`` endpoint returns a
 81        plain JSON array rather than a paginated envelope.  This method wraps
 82        the response into a :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult`
 83        so callers always receive a consistent return type.
 84
 85        Args:
 86            document_id: Numeric ID of the document whose history to retrieve.
 87            page: Forwarded to the API as a query parameter when provided.
 88                Effect depends on the paperless-ngx version; the server may
 89                ignore this parameter.
 90            page_size: Forwarded to the API as a query parameter when provided.
 91
 92        Returns:
 93            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
 94            :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.AuditLogEntry` objects,
 95            ordered by timestamp descending.
 96
 97        Raises:
 98            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
 99                with that ID.
100        """
101        logger.info("Fetching history for document id=%d", document_id)
102        path = f"/documents/{document_id}/history/"
103        params: dict[str, Any] = {}
104        if page is not None:
105            params["page"] = page
106        if page_size is not None:
107            params["page_size"] = page_size
108
109        resp = await self._core._session.get(path, params=params or None)
110        data = resp.json()
111
112        if isinstance(data, list):
113            entries = [AuditLogEntry.model_validate(item) for item in data]
114            entry_ids: list[int] = [e.id for e in entries]
115            return PagedResult(
116                count=len(entries),
117                next=None,
118                previous=None,
119                all=entry_ids if entry_ids else None,
120                results=entries,
121            )
122
123        # Forward-compatible: handle a paginated envelope if the API ever adds one.
124        items: list[Any] = list(data.get("results", []))
125        count: int = data.get("count", 0)
126        all_ids: list[int] | None = data.get("all")
127        return PagedResult(
128            count=count,
129            next=data.get("next"),
130            previous=data.get("previous"),
131            all=all_ids,
132            results=[AuditLogEntry.model_validate(item) for item in items],
133        )

151    async def get(self, id: int, *, include_metadata: bool = False) -> Document:
152        """Fetch a single document by its ID.
153
154        Args:
155            id: Numeric paperless-ngx document ID.
156            include_metadata: When ``True``, the extended file-level metadata
157                is fetched concurrently and attached to the document.
158                Default: ``False``.
159
160        Returns:
161            The :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document` with the
162            given ID.
163
164        Raises:
165            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
166                with that ID.
167        """
168        logger.info("Getting document id=%d", id)
169        if include_metadata:
170            doc_resp, meta_resp = await asyncio.gather(
171                self._core._session.get(f"/documents/{id}/"),
172                self._core._session.get(f"/documents/{id}/metadata/"),
173            )
174            data = doc_resp.json()
175            data["metadata"] = meta_resp.json()
176        else:
177            resp = await self._core._session.get(f"/documents/{id}/")
178            data = resp.json()
179        return Document.model_validate(data)

244    ) -> PagedResult[Document]:
245        """Return a filtered list of documents.
246
247        All tag, correspondent, document-type, storage-path, and custom-field
248        parameters accept either integer IDs or string names.
249
250        When ``page`` is ``None`` (the default), all pages are fetched
251        automatically and ``next`` / ``previous`` in the returned
252        :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` are always
253        ``None`` — even if ``max_results`` truncates the final result set.
254        ``count`` always reflects the server total, not the truncated length.
255        When ``page`` is set to a specific integer, only that one page is
256        fetched and ``next`` / ``previous`` contain the raw API values.
257
258        Args:
259            search: Search string.  Behaviour depends on ``search_mode``.
260            search_mode: How ``search`` is applied.  One of:
261                ``"title_or_content"`` *(default)*, ``"title"``, ``"query"``,
262                ``"original_filename"``.
263            ids: Return only documents whose ID is in this list.
264            tags: Documents must have **all** of these tags (AND semantics).
265            any_tags: Documents must have **at least one** of these tags.
266            exclude_tags: Documents must have **none** of these tags.
267            correspondent: Filter to documents assigned to this correspondent.
268                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no correspondent set.
269            any_correspondent: Filter to documents assigned to any of these.
270            exclude_correspondents: Exclude documents assigned to any of these.
271            document_type: Filter to documents of exactly this type.
272                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no document type set.
273            document_type_name_contains: Case-insensitive substring filter on document type name.
274            document_type_name_exact: Case-insensitive exact match on document type name.
275            any_document_type: Filter to documents whose type is any of these.
276            exclude_document_types: Exclude documents whose type is any of these.
277            storage_path: Filter to documents assigned to this storage path.
278                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no storage path set.
279            any_storage_paths: Filter to documents assigned to any of these paths.
280            exclude_storage_paths: Exclude documents assigned to any of these paths.
281            owner: Filter to documents owned by this user ID.
282                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no owner set.
283            exclude_owners: Exclude documents owned by any of these user IDs.
284            custom_fields: Documents must have **all** of these custom fields set.
285            any_custom_fields: Documents must have **at least one** of these fields.
286            exclude_custom_fields: Documents must have **none** of these fields.
287            custom_field_query: Filter documents by custom field values using a nested
288                query structure. See the `paperless-ngx API docs
289                <https://docs.paperless-ngx.com/api/#filtering-by-custom-fields>`_ for
290                the query format.
291            archive_serial_number: Filter by exact archive serial number.
292                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no ASN set.
293            archive_serial_number_from: Filter by ASN >= this value.
294            archive_serial_number_till: Filter by ASN <= this value.
295            created_after: Only documents created after this date.
296                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"``.
297            created_before: Only documents created before this date.
298                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"``.
299            added_after: Only documents added after this date/time.
300                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` for date precision or
301                ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"`` for datetime precision.
302            added_from: Only documents added on or after this date/time.
303                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
304            added_before: Only documents added before this date/time.
305                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
306            added_until: Only documents added on or before this date/time.
307                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
308            modified_after: Only documents modified after this date/time.
309                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
310            modified_from: Only documents modified on or after this date/time.
311                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
312            modified_before: Only documents modified before this date/time.
313                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
314            modified_until: Only documents modified on or before this date/time.
315                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
316            checksum: MD5 checksum (hex) of the original uploaded file, matched
317                exactly but case-insensitively (sent as ``checksum__iexact``).
318                Documents in the trash are **not** found, yet paperless-ngx
319                still rejects a re-upload of the same file as a duplicate.  To
320                detect that case, catch the
321                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError` of
322                ``upload(wait=True)`` (or of ``tasks.wait()``): ``err.task.result``
323                contains ``": It is a duplicate of "`` and ends in
324                ``"Note: existing document is in the trash."``, and
325                ``err.task.related_document`` is ``None`` (for a live duplicate
326                it is the existing document's ID).  ``client.trash.list()``
327                shows the trashed document; ``client.trash.restore()`` brings
328                it back.
329            page_size: Number of results per API page.  Default: ``25``.
330            page: Return only this specific page (1-based).
331            ordering: Field name to sort by.
332            descending: When ``True``, reverses the sort direction.
333            max_results: Stop after collecting this many documents.
334            on_page: Callback invoked after each page fetch.
335
336        Returns:
337            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
338            :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document` objects.
339        """
340        logger.info("Listing documents")
341        resolver = self._core._resolver
342        params: dict[str, Any] = {"page_size": page_size}
343
344        if search is not None:
345            api_param = _SEARCH_MODE_MAP.get(search_mode, "search")
346            params[api_param] = search
347
348        if ids is not None:
349            params["id__in"] = ",".join(str(i) for i in ids)
350
351        if tags is not None:
352            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", tags)
353            params["tags__id__all"] = ",".join(str(t) for t in resolved)
354
355        if any_tags is not None:
356            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", any_tags)
357            params["tags__id__in"] = ",".join(str(t) for t in resolved)
358
359        if exclude_tags is not None:
360            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", exclude_tags)
361            params["tags__id__none"] = ",".join(str(t) for t in resolved)
362
363        if any_correspondent is not None:
364            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("correspondents", any_correspondent)
365            params["correspondent__id__in"] = ",".join(str(c) for c in resolved)
366        elif not isinstance(correspondent, Unset):
367            if correspondent is None:
368                params["correspondent__isnull"] = "true"
369            else:
370                resolved_id = await resolver.resolve("correspondents", correspondent)
371                params["correspondent__id"] = resolved_id
372
373        if exclude_correspondents is not None:
374            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("correspondents", exclude_correspondents)
375            params["correspondent__id__none"] = ",".join(str(c) for c in resolved)
376
377        if document_type_name_contains is not None:
378            params["document_type__name__icontains"] = document_type_name_contains
379        if document_type_name_exact is not None:
380            params["document_type__name__iexact"] = document_type_name_exact
381
382        if any_document_type is not None:
383            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("document_types", any_document_type)
384            params["document_type__id__in"] = ",".join(str(d) for d in resolved)
385        elif not isinstance(document_type, Unset):
386            if document_type is None:
387                params["document_type__isnull"] = "true"
388            else:
389                resolved_id = await resolver.resolve("document_types", document_type)
390                params["document_type__id"] = resolved_id
391
392        if exclude_document_types is not None:
393            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("document_types", exclude_document_types)
394            params["document_type__id__none"] = ",".join(str(d) for d in resolved)
395
396        if any_storage_paths is not None:
397            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("storage_paths", any_storage_paths)
398            params["storage_path__id__in"] = ",".join(str(s) for s in resolved)
399        elif not isinstance(storage_path, Unset):
400            if storage_path is None:
401                params["storage_path__isnull"] = "true"
402            else:
403                resolved_id = await resolver.resolve("storage_paths", storage_path)
404                params["storage_path__id"] = resolved_id
405
406        if exclude_storage_paths is not None:
407            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("storage_paths", exclude_storage_paths)
408            params["storage_path__id__none"] = ",".join(str(s) for s in resolved)
409
410        if not isinstance(owner, Unset):
411            if owner is None:
412                params["owner__isnull"] = "true"
413            else:
414                params["owner__id"] = owner
415
416        if exclude_owners is not None:
417            params["owner__id__none"] = ",".join(str(o) for o in exclude_owners)
418
419        if custom_fields is not None:
420            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("custom_fields", custom_fields)
421            params["custom_fields__id__all"] = ",".join(str(f) for f in resolved)
422
423        if any_custom_fields is not None:
424            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("custom_fields", any_custom_fields)
425            params["custom_fields__id__in"] = ",".join(str(f) for f in resolved)
426
427        if exclude_custom_fields is not None:
428            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("custom_fields", exclude_custom_fields)
429            params["custom_fields__id__none"] = ",".join(str(f) for f in resolved)
430
431        if custom_field_query is not None:
432            params["custom_field_query"] = json.dumps(custom_field_query)
433
434        if not isinstance(archive_serial_number, Unset):
435            if archive_serial_number is None:
436                params["archive_serial_number__isnull"] = "true"
437            else:
438                params["archive_serial_number"] = archive_serial_number
439
440        if archive_serial_number_from is not None:
441            params["archive_serial_number__gte"] = archive_serial_number_from
442
443        if archive_serial_number_till is not None:
444            params["archive_serial_number__lte"] = archive_serial_number_till
445
446        if created_after is not None:
447            params["created__date__gt"] = self._format_date_value(created_after)
448
449        if created_before is not None:
450            params["created__date__lt"] = self._format_date_value(created_before)
451
452        if added_after is not None:
453            key = "added__gt" if self._is_datetime(added_after) else "added__date__gt"
454            params[key] = self._format_date_value(added_after)
455
456        if added_from is not None:
457            key = "added__gte" if self._is_datetime(added_from) else "added__date__gte"
458            params[key] = self._format_date_value(added_from)
459
460        if added_before is not None:
461            key = "added__lt" if self._is_datetime(added_before) else "added__date__lt"
462            params[key] = self._format_date_value(added_before)
463
464        if added_until is not None:
465            key = "added__lte" if self._is_datetime(added_until) else "added__date__lte"
466            params[key] = self._format_date_value(added_until)
467
468        if modified_after is not None:
469            key = "modified__gt" if self._is_datetime(modified_after) else "modified__date__gt"
470            params[key] = self._format_date_value(modified_after)
471
472        if modified_from is not None:
473            key = "modified__gte" if self._is_datetime(modified_from) else "modified__date__gte"
474            params[key] = self._format_date_value(modified_from)
475
476        if modified_before is not None:
477            key = "modified__lt" if self._is_datetime(modified_before) else "modified__date__lt"
478            params[key] = self._format_date_value(modified_before)
479
480        if modified_until is not None:
481            key = "modified__lte" if self._is_datetime(modified_until) else "modified__date__lte"
482            params[key] = self._format_date_value(modified_until)
483
484        if checksum is not None:
485            params["checksum__iexact"] = checksum
486
487        if ordering is not None:
488            params["ordering"] = f"-{ordering}" if descending else ordering
489
490        if page is not None:
491            params["page"] = page
492            raw = await self._core._session.get_page("/documents/", params=params)
493            items = raw.items
494            if max_results is not None:
495                items = items[:max_results]
496            return PagedResult(
497                count=raw.count,
498                next=raw.next,
499                previous=raw.previous,
500                all=raw.all_ids,
501                results=[Document.model_validate(item) for item in items],
502            )
503
504        raw = await self._core._session.get_all_pages_paged(
505            "/documents/", params, max_results=max_results, on_page=on_page
506        )
507        return PagedResult(
508            count=raw.count,
509            next=raw.next,
510            previous=raw.previous,
511            all=raw.all_ids,
512            results=[Document.model_validate(item) for item in raw.items],
513        )

Return a filtered list of documents.

All tag, correspondent, document-type, storage-path, and custom-field parameters accept either integer IDs or string names.

When page is None (the default), all pages are fetched automatically and next / previous in the returned ~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult are always None — even if max_results truncates the final result set. count always reflects the server total, not the truncated length. When page is set to a specific integer, only that one page is fetched and next / previous contain the raw API values.

Arguments:
  • search: Search string. Behaviour depends on search_mode.
  • search_mode: How search is applied. One of: "title_or_content" (default), "title", "query", "original_filename".
  • ids: Return only documents whose ID is in this list.
  • tags: Documents must have all of these tags (AND semantics).
  • any_tags: Documents must have at least one of these tags.
  • exclude_tags: Documents must have none of these tags.
  • correspondent: Filter to documents assigned to this correspondent. Pass None to return only documents with no correspondent set.
  • any_correspondent: Filter to documents assigned to any of these.
  • exclude_correspondents: Exclude documents assigned to any of these.
  • document_type: Filter to documents of exactly this type. Pass None to return only documents with no document type set.
  • document_type_name_contains: Case-insensitive substring filter on document type name.
  • document_type_name_exact: Case-insensitive exact match on document type name.
  • any_document_type: Filter to documents whose type is any of these.
  • exclude_document_types: Exclude documents whose type is any of these.
  • storage_path: Filter to documents assigned to this storage path. Pass None to return only documents with no storage path set.
  • any_storage_paths: Filter to documents assigned to any of these paths.
  • exclude_storage_paths: Exclude documents assigned to any of these paths.
  • owner: Filter to documents owned by this user ID. Pass None to return only documents with no owner set.
  • exclude_owners: Exclude documents owned by any of these user IDs.
  • custom_fields: Documents must have all of these custom fields set.
  • any_custom_fields: Documents must have at least one of these fields.
  • exclude_custom_fields: Documents must have none of these fields.
  • custom_field_query: Filter documents by custom field values using a nested query structure. See the paperless-ngx API docs for the query format.
  • archive_serial_number: Filter by exact archive serial number. Pass None to return only documents with no ASN set.
  • archive_serial_number_from: Filter by ASN >= this value.
  • archive_serial_number_till: Filter by ASN <= this value.
  • created_after: Only documents created after this date. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD".
  • created_before: Only documents created before this date. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD".
  • added_after: Only documents added after this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" for date precision or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS" for datetime precision.
  • added_from: Only documents added on or after this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • added_before: Only documents added before this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • added_until: Only documents added on or before this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • modified_after: Only documents modified after this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • modified_from: Only documents modified on or after this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • modified_before: Only documents modified before this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • modified_until: Only documents modified on or before this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • checksum: MD5 checksum (hex) of the original uploaded file, matched exactly but case-insensitively (sent as checksum__iexact). Documents in the trash are not found, yet paperless-ngx still rejects a re-upload of the same file as a duplicate. To detect that case, catch the ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError of upload(wait=True) (or of tasks.wait()): err.task.result contains ": It is a duplicate of " and ends in "Note: existing document is in the trash.", and err.task.related_document is None (for a live duplicate it is the existing document's ID). client.trash.list() shows the trashed document; client.trash.restore() brings it back.
  • page_size: Number of results per API page. Default: 25.
  • page: Return only this specific page (1-based).
  • ordering: Field name to sort by.
  • descending: When True, reverses the sort direction.
  • max_results: Stop after collecting this many documents.
  • on_page: Callback invoked after each page fetch.
Returns:

~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult of ~easypaperless.models.documents.Document objects.

async def update( self, id: int, *, title: str | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, content: str | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, created: datetime.date | str | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, correspondent: int | str | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, document_type: int | str | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, storage_path: int | str | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, tags: Union[List[Union[str, int]], NoneType, easypaperless.Unset] = UNSET, archive_serial_number: int | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, custom_fields: Union[List[dict[str, Any]], NoneType, easypaperless.Unset] = UNSET, owner: int | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, set_permissions: easypaperless.SetPermissions | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, remove_inbox_tags: bool | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET) -> easypaperless.Document: 
515    async def update(
516        self,
517        id: int,
518        *,
519        title: str | Unset = UNSET,
520        content: str | Unset = UNSET,
521        created: date | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
522        correspondent: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
523        document_type: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
524        storage_path: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
525        tags: List[int | str] | None | Unset = UNSET,
526        archive_serial_number: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
527        custom_fields: List[dict[str, Any]] | None | Unset = UNSET,
528        owner: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
529        set_permissions: SetPermissions | None | Unset = UNSET,
530        remove_inbox_tags: bool | None | Unset = UNSET,
531    ) -> Document:
532        """Partially update a document (PATCH semantics).
533
534        Args:
535            id: Numeric ID of the document to update.
536            title: New document title.
537            content: OCR text content of the document.
538            created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string (``"YYYY-MM-DD"``) or a
539                :class:`~datetime.date` object.
540            correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
541                Pass ``None`` to clear the correspondent.
542            document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
543                Pass ``None`` to clear the document type.
544            storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
545                Pass ``None`` to clear the storage path.
546            tags: Full replacement list of tags (IDs or names).
547            archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
548                Pass ``None`` to clear the archive serial number.
549            custom_fields: List of ``{"field": <field_id>, "value": ...}`` dicts.
550            owner: Numeric user ID to assign as document owner.
551                Pass ``None`` to clear the owner.
552            set_permissions: Explicit view/change permission sets.
553                Pass ``None`` to clear all permissions (overwrite with empty).
554                Omit (or pass :data:`~easypaperless.UNSET`) to leave unchanged.
555                The given sets replace the document's current view and change
556                users and groups.  Together with ``owner`` everything goes out
557                in one PATCH, which paperless-ngx applies as a whole.
558            remove_inbox_tags: When ``True``, removes all inbox tags from the document.
559
560        Returns:
561            The updated :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document`.
562        """
563        logger.info("Updating document id=%d", id)
564        resolver = self._core._resolver
565        payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
566
567        if not isinstance(title, Unset):
568            payload["title"] = title
569        if not isinstance(content, Unset):
570            payload["content"] = content
571        if not isinstance(created, Unset):
572            payload["created"] = self._format_date_value(created) if created is not None else None
573        if not isinstance(correspondent, Unset):
574            payload["correspondent"] = (
575                None
576                if correspondent is None
577                else await resolver.resolve("correspondents", correspondent)
578            )
579        if not isinstance(document_type, Unset):
580            payload["document_type"] = (
581                None
582                if document_type is None
583                else await resolver.resolve("document_types", document_type)
584            )
585        if not isinstance(storage_path, Unset):
586            payload["storage_path"] = (
587                None
588                if storage_path is None
589                else await resolver.resolve("storage_paths", storage_path)
590            )
591        if not isinstance(tags, Unset):
592            payload["tags"] = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", tags or [])
593        if not isinstance(archive_serial_number, Unset):
594            payload["archive_serial_number"] = archive_serial_number
595        if not isinstance(custom_fields, Unset):
596            payload["custom_fields"] = custom_fields
597        if not isinstance(owner, Unset):
598            payload["owner"] = owner
599        if not isinstance(set_permissions, Unset):
600            payload["set_permissions"] = (
601                SetPermissions().model_dump()
602                if set_permissions is None
603                else set_permissions.model_dump()
604            )
605        if not isinstance(remove_inbox_tags, Unset):
606            payload["remove_inbox_tags"] = remove_inbox_tags
607
608        resp = await self._core._session.patch(f"/documents/{id}/", json=payload)
609        return Document.model_validate(resp.json())

Partially update a document (PATCH semantics).

Arguments:
  • id: Numeric ID of the document to update.
  • title: New document title.
  • content: OCR text content of the document.
  • created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string ("YYYY-MM-DD") or a ~datetime.date object.
  • correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name. Pass None to clear the correspondent.
  • document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name. Pass None to clear the document type.
  • storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name. Pass None to clear the storage path.
  • tags: Full replacement list of tags (IDs or names).
  • archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign. Pass None to clear the archive serial number.
  • custom_fields: List of {"field": <field_id>, "value": ...} dicts.
  • owner: Numeric user ID to assign as document owner. Pass None to clear the owner.
  • set_permissions: Explicit view/change permission sets. Pass None to clear all permissions (overwrite with empty). Omit (or pass ~easypaperless.UNSET) to leave unchanged. The given sets replace the document's current view and change users and groups. Together with owner everything goes out in one PATCH, which paperless-ngx applies as a whole.
  • remove_inbox_tags: When True, removes all inbox tags from the document.
Returns:

The updated ~easypaperless.models.documents.Document.
