async def upload( self, file: str | pathlib._local.Path | bytes, *, filename: str | None = None, content_type: str | None = None, request_timeout: float | None = None, title: str | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, created: datetime.date | str | None = None, correspondent: int | str | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, document_type: int | str | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, storage_path: int | str | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, tags: Optional[List[Union[str, int]]] = None, archive_serial_number: int | None | easypaperless.Unset = UNSET, custom_fields: Optional[List[dict[str, Any]]] = None, wait: bool = False, poll_interval: float | None = None, poll_timeout: float | None = None) -> str | easypaperless.Document: 
663    async def upload(
664        self,
665        file: str | Path | bytes,
666        *,
667        filename: str | None = None,
668        content_type: str | None = None,
669        request_timeout: float | None = None,
670        title: str | Unset = UNSET,
671        created: date | str | None = None,
672        correspondent: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
673        document_type: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
674        storage_path: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
675        tags: List[int | str] | None = None,
676        archive_serial_number: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
677        custom_fields: List[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
678        wait: bool = False,
679        poll_interval: float | None = None,
680        poll_timeout: float | None = None,
681    ) -> str | Document:
682        """Upload a document to paperless-ngx.
683
684        The upload request is never retried automatically, whatever the
685        client's ``retry_attempts`` / ``tenacity_retrying`` settings: if the
686        connection fails after paperless-ngx has accepted the file, a retry
687        would create a duplicate.  A failed upload raises (e.g.
688        :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TransportTimeoutError`) so you can
689        decide whether to check for the document and upload again.
690
691        Args:
692            file: Path to the file to upload (``str`` or :class:`~pathlib.Path`),
693                or the file content as ``bytes``.  Bytes are sent directly; no
694                temporary file is written.
695            filename: File name sent to paperless-ngx.  Required when *file* is
696                ``bytes`` (omitting it raises
697                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError` before any
698                request).  For a path, overrides the name taken from the path.
699            content_type: MIME type of the file part, sent as given (e.g.
700                ``"application/pdf"``).  When omitted, it is guessed from the
701                file name as before.  paperless-ngx detects the file type from
702                the bytes and does not rely on this value to accept the file.
703            request_timeout: HTTP timeout in seconds for the upload request
704                only, overriding the client's ``timeout`` for this call.  Does
705                not affect task polling (see ``poll_timeout``).  When omitted,
706                the client's ``timeout`` applies.
707            title: Title to assign to the document.
708            created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string (``"YYYY-MM-DD"``) or a
709                :class:`~datetime.date` object.
710            correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
711            document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
712            storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
713            tags: Tags to assign, as IDs or names.
714            archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
715            custom_fields: List of ``{"field": <field_id>, "value": ...}`` dicts.
716            wait: If ``False`` *(default)*, returns immediately with the task ID.
717                If ``True``, polls until processing completes.
718            poll_interval: Seconds between task-status checks while waiting for
719                processing to complete (requires ``wait=True``). Overrides the
720                client-level default. When omitted, falls back to the client-level
721                ``poll_interval`` (``2.0`` s unless changed at construction).
722            poll_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait before raising
723                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError` (requires
724                ``wait=True``). Overrides the client-level default. When omitted,
725                falls back to the client-level ``poll_timeout`` (``60.0`` s unless
726                changed at construction).
727
728        Returns:
729            The Celery task ID string when ``wait=False``, or the fully
730            processed :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document`
731            when ``wait=True``.
732
733        Raises:
734            ~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError: If *file* is ``bytes``
735                and no *filename* is given.
736            ~easypaperless.exceptions.BadRequestError: If paperless-ngx rejects
737                the file before processing starts, e.g. an unsupported file
738                type or an empty file (``err.field_errors["document"]``).
739            ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError: If processing fails;
740                ``err.task`` holds the task with paperless-ngx's ``result``
741                unaltered.  For a duplicate, ``err.task.result`` contains
742                ``": It is a duplicate of "`` and ``err.task.related_document``
743                is the existing document's ID (``None`` if that document is
744                in the trash).
745            ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError: If timeout is exceeded;
746                resume with ``client.tasks.wait(err.task_id)``.
747        """
748        resolver = self._core._resolver
749        if isinstance(file, bytes):
750            if not filename:
751                raise ValidationError("filename is required when uploading from bytes")
752            file_bytes = file
753            upload_name = filename
754        else:
755            file_path = Path(file)
756            file_bytes = file_path.read_bytes()
757            upload_name = filename if filename is not None else file_path.name
758        logger.info("Uploading %r (%d bytes)", upload_name, len(file_bytes))
759
760        data: dict[str, Any] = {}
761        if not isinstance(title, Unset):
762            data["title"] = title
763        if created is not None:
764            data["created"] = self._format_date_value(created)
765        if not isinstance(correspondent, Unset) and correspondent is not None:
766            data["correspondent"] = await resolver.resolve("correspondents", correspondent)
767        if not isinstance(document_type, Unset) and document_type is not None:
768            data["document_type"] = await resolver.resolve("document_types", document_type)
769        if not isinstance(storage_path, Unset) and storage_path is not None:
770            data["storage_path"] = await resolver.resolve("storage_paths", storage_path)
771        if tags is not None:
772            resolved = await resolver.resolve_list("tags", tags)
773            data["tags"] = resolved
774        if not isinstance(archive_serial_number, Unset) and archive_serial_number is not None:
775            data["archive_serial_number"] = archive_serial_number
776        if custom_fields is not None:
777            data["custom_fields"] = json.dumps(custom_fields)
778
779        # Without content_type httpx derives it from the file name (previous behaviour).
780        document_part: tuple[str, bytes] | tuple[str, bytes, str] = (
781            (upload_name, file_bytes)
782            if content_type is None
783            else (upload_name, file_bytes, content_type)
784        )
785        files = {"document": document_part}
786        resp = await self._core._session.post(
787            "/documents/post_document/",
788            data=data,
789            files=files,
790            timeout=request_timeout,
791            retry=False,  # a retry after a lost response would upload a duplicate
792        )
793        task_id: str = resp.text.strip('"')
794        logger.debug("Upload accepted, task_id=%r", task_id)
795
796        if not wait:
797            return task_id
798
799        task = await self._core.tasks.wait(
800            task_id, poll_interval=poll_interval, poll_timeout=poll_timeout
801        )
802        if task.related_document is None:
803            raise UploadError(f"Task {task_id!r} succeeded but returned no document ID", task=task)
804        doc_id = int(task.related_document)
805        logger.info("Task %r produced document_id=%d", task_id, doc_id)
806        return await self.get(doc_id)

Upload a document to paperless-ngx.

The upload request is never retried automatically, whatever the client's retry_attempts / tenacity_retrying settings: if the connection fails after paperless-ngx has accepted the file, a retry would create a duplicate. A failed upload raises (e.g. ~easypaperless.exceptions.TransportTimeoutError) so you can decide whether to check for the document and upload again.

Arguments:
  • file: Path to the file to upload (str or ~pathlib.Path), or the file content as bytes. Bytes are sent directly; no temporary file is written.
  • filename: File name sent to paperless-ngx. Required when file is bytes (omitting it raises ~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError before any request). For a path, overrides the name taken from the path.
  • content_type: MIME type of the file part, sent as given (e.g. "application/pdf"). When omitted, it is guessed from the file name as before. paperless-ngx detects the file type from the bytes and does not rely on this value to accept the file.
  • request_timeout: HTTP timeout in seconds for the upload request only, overriding the client's timeout for this call. Does not affect task polling (see poll_timeout). When omitted, the client's timeout applies.
  • title: Title to assign to the document.
  • created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string ("YYYY-MM-DD") or a ~datetime.date object.
  • correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
  • document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
  • storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
  • tags: Tags to assign, as IDs or names.
  • archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
  • custom_fields: List of {"field": <field_id>, "value": ...} dicts.
  • wait: If False (default), returns immediately with the task ID. If True, polls until processing completes.
  • poll_interval: Seconds between task-status checks while waiting for processing to complete (requires wait=True). Overrides the client-level default. When omitted, falls back to the client-level poll_interval (2.0 s unless changed at construction).
  • poll_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait before raising ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError (requires wait=True). Overrides the client-level default. When omitted, falls back to the client-level poll_timeout (60.0 s unless changed at construction).
Returns:

The Celery task ID string when wait=False, or the fully processed ~easypaperless.models.documents.Document when wait=True.

Raises:
  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError: If file is bytes and no filename is given.
  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.BadRequestError: If paperless-ngx rejects the file before processing starts, e.g. an unsupported file type or an empty file (err.field_errors["document"]).
  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError: If processing fails; err.task holds the task with paperless-ngx's result unaltered. For a duplicate, err.task.result contains ": It is a duplicate of " and err.task.related_document is the existing document's ID (None if that document is in the trash).
  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError: If timeout is exceeded; resume with client.tasks.wait(err.task_id).

 18class NotesResource:
 19    """Accessor for document notes: ``client.documents.notes``."""
 20
 21    def __init__(self, core: _ClientCore) -> None:
 22        self._core = core
 23
 24    async def list(
 25        self,
 26        document_id: int,
 27        *,
 28        page: int | None = None,
 29        page_size: int | None = None,
 30    ) -> PagedResult[DocumentNote]:
 31        """Fetch notes attached to a document.
 32
 33        When ``page`` is ``None`` (the default), all pages are fetched
 34        automatically and ``next`` / ``previous`` in the returned
 35        :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` are always
 36        ``None``.  When ``page`` is set to a specific integer, only that one
 37        page is fetched and ``next`` / ``previous`` contain the raw API values.
 38
 39        Args:
 40            document_id: Numeric ID of the document whose notes to retrieve.
 41            page: Return only this specific page (1-based).
 42            page_size: Number of results per page.
 43
 44        Returns:
 45            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
 46            :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.DocumentNote` objects,
 47            ordered by creation time.
 48
 49        Raises:
 50            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
 51                with that ID.
 52        """
 53        logger.info("Listing notes for document id=%d", document_id)
 54        path = f"/documents/{document_id}/notes/"
 55        params: dict[str, Any] = {}
 56        if page_size is not None:
 57            params["page_size"] = page_size
 58        if page is not None:
 59            params["page"] = page
 60
 61        raw = await self._core._session.get_list(
 62            path, params=params or None, all_pages=page is None
 63        )
 64        notes = [DocumentNote.model_validate(item) for item in raw.items]
 65        all_ids = raw.all_ids
 66        if not raw.paginated:
 67            # paperless-ngx answers with a plain JSON array: list the note IDs.
 68            all_ids = [n.id for n in notes if n.id is not None] or None
 69        return PagedResult(
 70            count=raw.count,
 71            next=raw.next,
 72            previous=raw.previous,
 73            all=all_ids,
 74            results=notes,
 75        )
 76
 77    async def create(self, document_id: int, *, note: str) -> DocumentNote:
 78        """Create a new note on a document.
 79
 80        Args:
 81            document_id: Numeric ID of the document to annotate.
 82            note: Text content of the note.
 83
 84        Returns:
 85            The newly created :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.DocumentNote`.
 86
 87        Raises:
 88            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
 89                with that ID.
 90        """
 91        logger.info("Creating note for document id=%d", document_id)
 92        resp = await self._core._session.post(
 93            f"/documents/{document_id}/notes/",
 94            json={"note": note},
 95            retry=False,  # a retry after a lost response could add the note twice
 96        )
 97        data = resp.json()
 98        if isinstance(data, list):
 99            return DocumentNote.model_validate(data[-1])
100        return DocumentNote.model_validate(data)
101
102    async def delete(self, document_id: int, note_id: int) -> None:
103        """Delete a note from a document.
104
105        Args:
106            document_id: Numeric ID of the document that owns the note.
107            note_id: Numeric ID of the note to delete.
108
109        Raises:
110            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists with
111                that ID.
112            ~easypaperless.exceptions.ServerResponseError: If the document has
113                no note with ``note_id``.  paperless-ngx answers an unknown note
114                ID with ``500 Server Error`` instead of 404 (verified against
115                paperless-ngx 2.18.2), so it cannot be told apart from a real
116                server error.  With ``retry_attempts`` set, the 500 is retried
117                like any other and ends in
118                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.RetryExhaustedError`.  Use
119                ``notes.list(document_id)`` first if you need to be sure the
120                note exists.
121        """
122        logger.info("Deleting note id=%d from document id=%d", note_id, document_id)
123        await self._core._session.delete(f"/documents/{document_id}/notes/", params={"id": note_id})

  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.ServerResponseError: If the document has no note with note_id. paperless-ngx answers an unknown note ID with 500 Server Error instead of 404 (verified against paperless-ngx 2.18.2), so it cannot be told apart from a real server error. With retry_attempts set, the 500 is retried like any other and ends in ~easypaperless.exceptions.RetryExhaustedError. Use notes.list(document_id) first if you need to be sure the note exists.

156        :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` are always
157        ``None`` — even if ``max_results`` truncates the final result set.
158        ``count`` always reflects the server total, not the truncated length.
159        When ``page`` is set to a specific integer, only that one page is
160        fetched and ``next`` / ``previous`` contain the raw API values.
161
162        Args:
163            search: Search string.  Behaviour depends on ``search_mode``.
164            search_mode: How ``search`` is applied.  One of:
165                ``"title_or_content"`` *(default)*, ``"title"``, ``"query"``,
166                ``"original_filename"``.
167            ids: Return only documents whose ID is in this list.
168            tags: Documents must have **all** of these tags (AND semantics).
169            any_tags: Documents must have **at least one** of these tags.
170            exclude_tags: Documents must have **none** of these tags.
171            correspondent: Filter to documents assigned to this correspondent.
172                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no correspondent set.
173            any_correspondent: Filter to documents assigned to any of these.
174            exclude_correspondents: Exclude documents assigned to any of these.
175            document_type: Filter to documents of exactly this type.
176                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no document type set.
177            document_type_name_contains: Case-insensitive substring filter on document type name.
178            document_type_name_exact: Case-insensitive exact match on document type name.
179            any_document_type: Filter to documents whose type is any of these.
180            exclude_document_types: Exclude documents whose type is any of these.
181            storage_path: Filter to documents assigned to this storage path.
182                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no storage path set.
183            any_storage_paths: Filter to documents assigned to any of these paths.
184            exclude_storage_paths: Exclude documents assigned to any of these paths.
185            owner: Filter to documents owned by this user ID.
186                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no owner set.
187            exclude_owners: Exclude documents owned by any of these user IDs.
188            custom_fields: Documents must have **all** of these custom fields set.
189            any_custom_fields: Documents must have **at least one** of these fields.
190            exclude_custom_fields: Documents must have **none** of these fields.
191            custom_field_query: Filter documents by custom field values using a nested
192                query structure. See the `paperless-ngx API docs
193                <https://docs.paperless-ngx.com/api/#filtering-by-custom-fields>`_ for
194                the query format.
195            archive_serial_number: Filter by exact archive serial number.
196                Pass ``None`` to return only documents with no ASN set.
197            archive_serial_number_from: Filter by ASN >= this value.
198            archive_serial_number_till: Filter by ASN <= this value.
199            created_after: Only documents created after this date.
200                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"``.
201            created_before: Only documents created before this date.
202                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"``.
203            added_after: Only documents added after this date/time.
204                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` for date precision or
205                ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"`` for datetime precision.
206            added_from: Only documents added on or after this date/time.
207                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
208            added_before: Only documents added before this date/time.
209                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
210            added_until: Only documents added on or before this date/time.
211                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
212            modified_after: Only documents modified after this date/time.
213                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
214            modified_from: Only documents modified on or after this date/time.
215                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
216            modified_before: Only documents modified before this date/time.
217                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
218            modified_until: Only documents modified on or before this date/time.
219                String input must be ISO-8601: ``"YYYY-MM-DD"`` or ``"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"``.
220            checksum: MD5 checksum (hex) of the original uploaded file, matched
221                exactly but case-insensitively (sent as ``checksum__iexact``).
222                Documents in the trash are **not** found, yet paperless-ngx
223                still rejects a re-upload of the same file as a duplicate.  To
224                detect that case, catch the
225                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError` of
226                ``upload(wait=True)`` (or of ``tasks.wait()``): ``err.task.result``
227                contains ``": It is a duplicate of "`` and ends in
228                ``"Note: existing document is in the trash."``, and
229                ``err.task.related_document`` is ``None`` (for a live duplicate
230                it is the existing document's ID).  ``client.trash.list()``
231                shows the trashed document; ``client.trash.restore()`` brings
232                it back.
233            page_size: Number of results per API page.  Default: ``25``.
234            page: Return only this specific page (1-based).
235            ordering: Field name to sort by.
236            descending: When ``True``, reverses the sort direction.
237            max_results: Stop after collecting this many documents.
238            on_page: Callback invoked after each page fetch.
239
240        Returns:
241            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
242            :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document` objects.
243        """
244        return cast(
245            PagedResult[Document],
246            self._run(
247                self._async_documents.list(
248                    search=search,
249                    search_mode=search_mode,
250                    ids=ids,
251                    tags=tags,
252                    any_tags=any_tags,
253                    exclude_tags=exclude_tags,
254                    correspondent=correspondent,
255                    any_correspondent=any_correspondent,
256                    exclude_correspondents=exclude_correspondents,
257                    document_type=document_type,
258                    document_type_name_contains=document_type_name_contains,
259                    document_type_name_exact=document_type_name_exact,
260                    any_document_type=any_document_type,
261                    exclude_document_types=exclude_document_types,
262                    storage_path=storage_path,
263                    any_storage_paths=any_storage_paths,
264                    exclude_storage_paths=exclude_storage_paths,
265                    owner=owner,
266                    exclude_owners=exclude_owners,
267                    custom_fields=custom_fields,
268                    any_custom_fields=any_custom_fields,
269                    exclude_custom_fields=exclude_custom_fields,
270                    custom_field_query=custom_field_query,
271                    archive_serial_number=archive_serial_number,
272                    archive_serial_number_from=archive_serial_number_from,
273                    archive_serial_number_till=archive_serial_number_till,
274                    created_after=created_after,
275                    created_before=created_before,
276                    added_after=added_after,
277                    added_from=added_from,
278                    added_before=added_before,
279                    added_until=added_until,
280                    modified_after=modified_after,
281                    modified_from=modified_from,
282                    modified_before=modified_before,
283                    modified_until=modified_until,
284                    checksum=checksum,
285                    page_size=page_size,
286                    page=page,
287                    ordering=ordering,
288                    descending=descending,
289                    max_results=max_results,
290                    on_page=on_page,
291                )
292            ),
293        )

296        self,
297        id: int,
298        *,
299        title: str | Unset = UNSET,
300        content: str | Unset = UNSET,
301        created: date | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
302        correspondent: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
303        document_type: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
304        storage_path: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
305        tags: List[int | str] | None | Unset = UNSET,
306        archive_serial_number: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
307        custom_fields: List[dict[str, Any]] | None | Unset = UNSET,
308        owner: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
309        set_permissions: SetPermissions | None | Unset = UNSET,
310        remove_inbox_tags: bool | None | Unset = UNSET,
311    ) -> Document:
312        """Partially update a document (PATCH semantics).
313
314        Args:
315            id: Numeric ID of the document to update.
316            title: New document title.
317            content: OCR text content of the document.
318            created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string (``"YYYY-MM-DD"``) or a
319                :class:`~datetime.date` object.
320            correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
321                Pass ``None`` to clear the correspondent.
322            document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
323                Pass ``None`` to clear the document type.
324            storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
325                Pass ``None`` to clear the storage path.
326            tags: Full replacement list of tags (IDs or names).
327            archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
328                Pass ``None`` to clear the archive serial number.
329            custom_fields: List of ``{"field": <field_id>, "value": ...}`` dicts.
330            owner: Numeric user ID to assign as document owner.
331                Pass ``None`` to clear the owner.
332            set_permissions: Explicit view/change permission sets.
333                Pass ``None`` to clear all permissions (overwrite with empty).
334                Omit (or pass :data:`~easypaperless.UNSET`) to leave unchanged.
335                The given sets replace the document's current view and change
336                users and groups.  Together with ``owner`` everything goes out
337                in one PATCH, which paperless-ngx applies as a whole.
338            remove_inbox_tags: When ``True``, removes all inbox tags from the document.
339
340        Returns:
341            The updated :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document`.
342        """
343        return cast(
344            Document,
345            self._run(
346                self._async_documents.update(
347                    id,
348                    title=title,
349                    content=content,
350                    created=created,
351                    correspondent=correspondent,
352                    document_type=document_type,
353                    storage_path=storage_path,
354                    tags=tags,
355                    archive_serial_number=archive_serial_number,
356                    custom_fields=custom_fields,
357                    owner=owner,
358                    set_permissions=set_permissions,
359                    remove_inbox_tags=remove_inbox_tags,
360                )
361            ),
362        )

408    def upload(
409        self,
410        file: str | Path | bytes,
411        *,
412        filename: str | None = None,
413        content_type: str | None = None,
414        request_timeout: float | None = None,
415        title: str | Unset = UNSET,
416        created: date | str | None = None,
417        correspondent: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
418        document_type: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
419        storage_path: int | str | None | Unset = UNSET,
420        tags: List[int | str] | None = None,
421        archive_serial_number: int | None | Unset = UNSET,
422        custom_fields: List[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
423        wait: bool = False,
424        poll_interval: float | None = None,
425        poll_timeout: float | None = None,
426    ) -> str | Document:
427        """Upload a document to paperless-ngx.
428
429        The upload request is never retried automatically, whatever the
430        client's ``retry_attempts`` / ``tenacity_retrying`` settings: if the
431        connection fails after paperless-ngx has accepted the file, a retry
432        would create a duplicate.  A failed upload raises (e.g.
433        :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TransportTimeoutError`) so you can
434        decide whether to check for the document and upload again.
435
436        Args:
437            file: Path to the file to upload (``str`` or :class:`~pathlib.Path`),
438                or the file content as ``bytes``.  Bytes are sent directly; no
439                temporary file is written.
440            filename: File name sent to paperless-ngx.  Required when *file* is
441                ``bytes`` (omitting it raises
442                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError` before any
443                request).  For a path, overrides the name taken from the path.
444            content_type: MIME type of the file part, sent as given (e.g.
445                ``"application/pdf"``).  When omitted, it is guessed from the
446                file name as before.  paperless-ngx detects the file type from
447                the bytes and does not rely on this value to accept the file.
448            request_timeout: HTTP timeout in seconds for the upload request
449                only, overriding the client's ``timeout`` for this call.  Does
450                not affect task polling (see ``poll_timeout``).  When omitted,
451                the client's ``timeout`` applies.
452            title: Title to assign to the document.
453            created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string (``"YYYY-MM-DD"``) or a
454                :class:`~datetime.date` object.
455            correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
456            document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
457            storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
458            tags: Tags to assign, as IDs or names.
459            archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
460            custom_fields: List of ``{"field": <field_id>, "value": ...}`` dicts.
461            wait: If ``False`` *(default)*, returns immediately with the task ID.
462                If ``True``, polls until processing completes.
463            poll_interval: Seconds between task-status checks while waiting for
464                processing to complete (requires ``wait=True``). Overrides the
465                client-level default. When omitted, falls back to the client-level
466                ``poll_interval`` (``2.0`` s unless changed at construction).
467            poll_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait before raising
468                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError` (requires
469                ``wait=True``). Overrides the client-level default. When omitted,
470                falls back to the client-level ``poll_timeout`` (``60.0`` s unless
471                changed at construction).
472
473        Returns:
474            The Celery task ID string when ``wait=False``, or the fully
475            processed :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document`
476            when ``wait=True``.
477
478        Raises:
479            ~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError: If *file* is ``bytes``
480                and no *filename* is given.
481            ~easypaperless.exceptions.BadRequestError: If paperless-ngx rejects
482                the file before processing starts, e.g. an unsupported file
483                type or an empty file (``err.field_errors["document"]``).
484            ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError: If processing fails;
485                ``err.task`` holds the task with paperless-ngx's ``result``
486                unaltered.  For a duplicate, ``err.task.result`` contains
487                ``": It is a duplicate of "`` and ``err.task.related_document``
488                is the existing document's ID (``None`` if that document is
489                in the trash).
490            ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError: If timeout is exceeded;
491                resume with ``client.tasks.wait(err.task_id)``.
492        """
493        return cast(
494            str | Document,
495            self._run(
496                self._async_documents.upload(
497                    file,
498                    filename=filename,
499                    content_type=content_type,
500                    request_timeout=request_timeout,
501                    title=title,
502                    created=created,
503                    correspondent=correspondent,
504                    document_type=document_type,
505                    storage_path=storage_path,
506                    tags=tags,
507                    archive_serial_number=archive_serial_number,
508                    custom_fields=custom_fields,
509                    wait=wait,
510                    poll_interval=poll_interval,
511                    poll_timeout=poll_timeout,
512                )
513            ),
514        )

Fetch the audit log for a document.

The paperless-ngx /api/documents/{id}/history/ endpoint returns a plain JSON array rather than a paginated envelope. This method wraps the response into a ~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult so callers always receive a consistent return type.

Arguments:

Return a filtered list of documents.

All tag, correspondent, document-type, storage-path, and custom-field parameters accept either integer IDs or string names.

When page is None (the default), all pages are fetched automatically and next / previous in the returned ~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult are always None — even if max_results truncates the final result set. count always reflects the server total, not the truncated length. When page is set to a specific integer, only that one page is fetched and next / previous contain the raw API values.

  • search_mode: How search is applied. One of: "title_or_content" (default), "title", "query", "original_filename".

  • any_tags: Documents must have at least one of these tags.
  • exclude_tags: Documents must have none of these tags.

  • document_type_name_contains: Case-insensitive substring filter on document type name.
  • document_type_name_exact: Case-insensitive exact match on document type name.
  • any_document_type: Filter to documents whose type is any of these.
  • exclude_document_types: Exclude documents whose type is any of these.
  • storage_path: Filter to documents assigned to this storage path. Pass None to return only documents with no storage path set.
  • any_storage_paths: Filter to documents assigned to any of these paths.
  • exclude_storage_paths: Exclude documents assigned to any of these paths.
  • owner: Filter to documents owned by this user ID. Pass None to return only documents with no owner set.
  • exclude_owners: Exclude documents owned by any of these user IDs.
  • custom_fields: Documents must have all of these custom fields set.
  • any_custom_fields: Documents must have at least one of these fields.
  • exclude_custom_fields: Documents must have none of these fields.
  • custom_field_query: Filter documents by custom field values using a nested query structure. See the paperless-ngx API docs for the query format.
  • archive_serial_number: Filter by exact archive serial number. Pass None to return only documents with no ASN set.
  • archive_serial_number_from: Filter by ASN >= this value.
  • archive_serial_number_till: Filter by ASN <= this value.
  • created_after: Only documents created after this date. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD".
  • created_before: Only documents created before this date. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD".
  • added_after: Only documents added after this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" for date precision or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS" for datetime precision.
  • added_from: Only documents added on or after this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • added_before: Only documents added before this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • added_until: Only documents added on or before this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • modified_after: Only documents modified after this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • modified_from: Only documents modified on or after this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • modified_before: Only documents modified before this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • modified_until: Only documents modified on or before this date/time. String input must be ISO-8601: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS".
  • checksum: MD5 checksum (hex) of the original uploaded file, matched exactly but case-insensitively (sent as checksum__iexact). Documents in the trash are not found, yet paperless-ngx still rejects a re-upload of the same file as a duplicate. To detect that case, catch the ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError of upload(wait=True) (or of tasks.wait()): err.task.result contains ": It is a duplicate of " and ends in "Note: existing document is in the trash.", and err.task.related_document is None (for a live duplicate it is the existing document's ID). client.trash.list() shows the trashed document; client.trash.restore() brings it back.
  • page_size: Number of results per API page. Default: 25.

427        """Upload a document to paperless-ngx.
428
429        The upload request is never retried automatically, whatever the
430        client's ``retry_attempts`` / ``tenacity_retrying`` settings: if the
431        connection fails after paperless-ngx has accepted the file, a retry
432        would create a duplicate.  A failed upload raises (e.g.
433        :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TransportTimeoutError`) so you can
434        decide whether to check for the document and upload again.
435
436        Args:
437            file: Path to the file to upload (``str`` or :class:`~pathlib.Path`),
438                or the file content as ``bytes``.  Bytes are sent directly; no
439                temporary file is written.
440            filename: File name sent to paperless-ngx.  Required when *file* is
441                ``bytes`` (omitting it raises
442                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError` before any
443                request).  For a path, overrides the name taken from the path.
444            content_type: MIME type of the file part, sent as given (e.g.
445                ``"application/pdf"``).  When omitted, it is guessed from the
446                file name as before.  paperless-ngx detects the file type from
447                the bytes and does not rely on this value to accept the file.
448            request_timeout: HTTP timeout in seconds for the upload request
449                only, overriding the client's ``timeout`` for this call.  Does
450                not affect task polling (see ``poll_timeout``).  When omitted,
451                the client's ``timeout`` applies.
452            title: Title to assign to the document.
453            created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string (``"YYYY-MM-DD"``) or a
454                :class:`~datetime.date` object.
455            correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
456            document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
457            storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
458            tags: Tags to assign, as IDs or names.
459            archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
460            custom_fields: List of ``{"field": <field_id>, "value": ...}`` dicts.
461            wait: If ``False`` *(default)*, returns immediately with the task ID.
462                If ``True``, polls until processing completes.
463            poll_interval: Seconds between task-status checks while waiting for
464                processing to complete (requires ``wait=True``). Overrides the
465                client-level default. When omitted, falls back to the client-level
466                ``poll_interval`` (``2.0`` s unless changed at construction).
467            poll_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait before raising
468                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError` (requires
469                ``wait=True``). Overrides the client-level default. When omitted,
470                falls back to the client-level ``poll_timeout`` (``60.0`` s unless
471                changed at construction).
472
473        Returns:
474            The Celery task ID string when ``wait=False``, or the fully
475            processed :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.Document`
476            when ``wait=True``.
477
478        Raises:
479            ~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError: If *file* is ``bytes``
480                and no *filename* is given.
481            ~easypaperless.exceptions.BadRequestError: If paperless-ngx rejects
482                the file before processing starts, e.g. an unsupported file
483                type or an empty file (``err.field_errors["document"]``).
484            ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError: If processing fails;
485                ``err.task`` holds the task with paperless-ngx's ``result``
486                unaltered.  For a duplicate, ``err.task.result`` contains
487                ``": It is a duplicate of "`` and ``err.task.related_document``
488                is the existing document's ID (``None`` if that document is
489                in the trash).
490            ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError: If timeout is exceeded;
491                resume with ``client.tasks.wait(err.task_id)``.
492        """
493        return cast(
494            str | Document,
495            self._run(
496                self._async_documents.upload(
497                    file,
498                    filename=filename,
499                    content_type=content_type,
500                    request_timeout=request_timeout,
501                    title=title,
502                    created=created,
503                    correspondent=correspondent,
504                    document_type=document_type,
505                    storage_path=storage_path,
506                    tags=tags,
507                    archive_serial_number=archive_serial_number,
508                    custom_fields=custom_fields,
509                    wait=wait,
510                    poll_interval=poll_interval,
511                    poll_timeout=poll_timeout,
512                )
513            ),
514        )

Upload a document to paperless-ngx.

The upload request is never retried automatically, whatever the client's retry_attempts / tenacity_retrying settings: if the connection fails after paperless-ngx has accepted the file, a retry would create a duplicate. A failed upload raises (e.g. ~easypaperless.exceptions.TransportTimeoutError) so you can decide whether to check for the document and upload again.

Arguments:
  • file: Path to the file to upload (str or ~pathlib.Path), or the file content as bytes. Bytes are sent directly; no temporary file is written.
  • filename: File name sent to paperless-ngx. Required when file is bytes (omitting it raises ~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError before any request). For a path, overrides the name taken from the path.
  • content_type: MIME type of the file part, sent as given (e.g. "application/pdf"). When omitted, it is guessed from the file name as before. paperless-ngx detects the file type from the bytes and does not rely on this value to accept the file.
  • request_timeout: HTTP timeout in seconds for the upload request only, overriding the client's timeout for this call. Does not affect task polling (see poll_timeout). When omitted, the client's timeout applies.
  • title: Title to assign to the document.
  • created: Creation date as an ISO-8601 string ("YYYY-MM-DD") or a ~datetime.date object.
  • correspondent: Correspondent to assign, as an ID or name.
  • document_type: Document type to assign, as an ID or name.
  • storage_path: Storage path to assign, as an ID or name.
  • tags: Tags to assign, as IDs or names.
  • archive_serial_number: Archive serial number to assign.
  • custom_fields: List of {"field": <field_id>, "value": ...} dicts.
  • wait: If False (default), returns immediately with the task ID. If True, polls until processing completes.
  • poll_interval: Seconds between task-status checks while waiting for processing to complete (requires wait=True). Overrides the client-level default. When omitted, falls back to the client-level poll_interval (2.0 s unless changed at construction).
  • poll_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait before raising ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError (requires wait=True). Overrides the client-level default. When omitted, falls back to the client-level poll_timeout (60.0 s unless changed at construction).
Returns:

The Celery task ID string when wait=False, or the fully processed ~easypaperless.models.documents.Document when wait=True.

Raises:
  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.ValidationError: If file is bytes and no filename is given.
  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.BadRequestError: If paperless-ngx rejects the file before processing starts, e.g. an unsupported file type or an empty file (err.field_errors["document"]).
  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError: If processing fails; err.task holds the task with paperless-ngx's result unaltered. For a duplicate, err.task.result contains ": It is a duplicate of " and err.task.related_document is the existing document's ID (None if that document is in the trash).
  • ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError: If timeout is exceeded; resume with client.tasks.wait(err.task_id).

15class SyncNotesResource:
16    """Sync accessor for document notes: ``client.documents.notes``."""

18    def __init__(self, async_notes: NotesResource, run: Any) -> None:
19        self._async_notes = async_notes
20        self._run = run
21
22    def list(
23        self,
24        document_id: int,
25        *,
26        page: int | None = None,
27        page_size: int | None = None,
28    ) -> PagedResult[DocumentNote]:
29        """Fetch notes attached to a document.
30
31        When ``page`` is ``None`` (the default), all pages are fetched
32        automatically and ``next`` / ``previous`` in the returned
33        :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` are always
34        ``None``.  When ``page`` is set to a specific integer, only that one
35        page is fetched and ``next`` / ``previous`` contain the raw API values.
36
37        Args:
38            document_id: Numeric ID of the document whose notes to retrieve.
39            page: Return only this specific page (1-based).
40            page_size: Number of results per page.
41
42        Returns:
43            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
44            :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.DocumentNote` objects,
45            ordered by creation time.
46
47        Raises:
48            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
49                with that ID.
50        """
51        return cast(
52            PagedResult[DocumentNote],
53            self._run(self._async_notes.list(document_id, page=page, page_size=page_size)),
54        )
55
56    def create(self, document_id: int, *, note: str) -> DocumentNote:
57        """Create a new note on a document.
58
59        Args:
60            document_id: Numeric ID of the document to annotate.
61            note: Text content of the note.
62
63        Returns:
64            The newly created :class:`~easypaperless.models.documents.DocumentNote`.
65
66        Raises:
67            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists
68                with that ID.
69        """
70        return cast(DocumentNote, self._run(self._async_notes.create(document_id, note=note)))
71
72    def delete(self, document_id: int, note_id: int) -> None:
73        """Delete a note from a document.
74
75        Args:
76            document_id: Numeric ID of the document that owns the note.
77            note_id: Numeric ID of the note to delete.
78
79        Raises:
80            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If no document exists with
81                that ID.
82            ~easypaperless.exceptions.ServerResponseError: If the document has
83                no note with ``note_id``.  paperless-ngx answers an unknown note
84                ID with ``500 Server Error`` instead of 404 (verified against
85                paperless-ngx 2.18.2), so it cannot be told apart from a real
86                server error.  With ``retry_attempts`` set, the 500 is retried
87                like any other and ends in
88                :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.RetryExhaustedError`.  Use
89                ``notes.list(document_id)`` first if you need to be sure the
90                note exists.
91        """
92        self._run(self._async_notes.delete(document_id, note_id))

22    def __init__(self, core: _ClientCore) -> None:

25    async def list(
26        self,
27        *,
28        page: int | Unset = UNSET,
29        page_size: int | Unset = UNSET,
30    ) -> PagedResult[Document]:
31        """Return all documents currently in the trash.
32
33        When ``page`` is ``UNSET`` (the default), all pages are fetched
34        automatically and ``next`` / ``previous`` in the result are always
35        ``None``.  When ``page`` is set, only that page is fetched and
36        ``next`` / ``previous`` reflect the raw API values.

45            in the trash.
46        """
47        logger.info("Listing trashed documents")
48        params: dict[str, Any] = {}
49        if not isinstance(page, Unset):
50            params["page"] = page
51        if not isinstance(page_size, Unset):
52            params["page_size"] = page_size
53        return cast(
54            PagedResult[Document],
55            await self._core._list_resource("trash", Document, params or None),
56        )
57
58    async def restore(self, document_ids: List[int]) -> None:
59        """Restore trashed documents back to active status.
60
61        Args:
62            document_ids: List of numeric document IDs to restore.
63        """
64        logger.info("Restoring %d trashed document(s)", len(document_ids))
65        await self._core._session.post(
66            "/trash/",
67            json={"documents": document_ids, "action": "restore"},
68        )
69
70    async def empty(self, document_ids: List[int]) -> None:
71        """Permanently delete trashed documents.
72
73        .. warning::
74            **This operation is irreversible and cannot be undone.**
75            The documents will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered.
76
77        Args:
78            document_ids: List of numeric document IDs to permanently delete.
79        """
80        logger.info("Permanently deleting %d trashed document(s)", len(document_ids))
81        await self._core._session.post(
82            "/trash/",
83            json={"documents": document_ids, "action": "empty"},
84        )

 23class TasksResource:
 24    """Accessor for paperless-ngx background tasks: ``client.tasks``."""
 25
 26    def __init__(self, core: _ClientCore) -> None:
 27        self._core = core
 28
 29    async def list(
 30        self,
 31        *,
 32        task_id: str | Unset = UNSET,
 33        status: TaskStatus | str | Unset = UNSET,
 34        task_name: str | Unset = UNSET,
 35        type: str | Unset = UNSET,
 36        acknowledged: bool | Unset = UNSET,
 37    ) -> PagedResult[Task]:
 38        """Return background tasks, optionally filtered.
 39
 40        paperless-ngx returns the task list as a plain JSON array (not
 41        paginated); it is wrapped into a
 42        :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` with
 43        ``next`` / ``previous`` set to ``None``.  A paginated response is
 44        accepted as well, and all its pages are fetched.
 45
 46        Args:
 47            task_id: Only the task with this Celery task ID (UUID string).
 48            status: Only tasks with this status, e.g. ``TaskStatus.FAILURE``
 49                or ``"FAILURE"``.
 50            task_name: Only tasks with this name: ``"consume_file"``,
 51                ``"train_classifier"``, ``"check_sanity"`` or
 52                ``"index_optimize"``.
 53            type: Only tasks of this type: ``"auto_task"``,
 54                ``"scheduled_task"`` or ``"manual_task"``.
 55            acknowledged: ``False`` for tasks not yet acknowledged (as shown
 56                in the paperless-ngx UI), ``True`` for acknowledged ones.
 57
 58        Returns:
 59            :class:`~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult` of
 60            :class:`~easypaperless.models.tasks.Task` objects.
 61
 62        Raises:
 63            ~easypaperless.exceptions.BadRequestError: If ``status``,
 64                ``task_name`` or ``type`` is not one of paperless-ngx's values.
 65                These filters are case-sensitive (``"success"`` is rejected).
 66        """
 67        logger.info("Listing tasks")
 68        filters = {
 69            "task_id": task_id,
 70            "status": status,
 71            "task_name": task_name,
 72            "type": type,
 73            "acknowledged": acknowledged,
 74        }
 75        params: dict[str, Any] = {k: v for k, v in filters.items() if not isinstance(v, Unset)}
 76        raw = await self._core._session.get_list("/tasks/", params=params or None)
 77        return PagedResult(
 78            count=raw.count,
 79            all=raw.all_ids,
 80            results=[Task.model_validate(item) for item in raw.items],
 81        )
 82
 83    async def get(self, task_id: str) -> Task:
 84        """Fetch a single task by its Celery task ID.
 85
 86        Args:
 87            task_id: The task's UUID string, e.g. as returned by
 88                ``documents.upload(wait=False)``.
 89
 90        Returns:
 91            The :class:`~easypaperless.models.tasks.Task`.
 92
 93        Raises:
 94            ~easypaperless.exceptions.NotFoundError: If paperless-ngx does not
 95                know a task with this ID.
 96        """
 97        logger.info("Getting task task_id=%r", task_id)
 98        task = await self._fetch(task_id)
 99        if task is None:
100            raise NotFoundError(f"Task {task_id!r} not found")
101        return task
102
103    async def wait(
104        self,
105        task_id: str,
106        *,
107        poll_interval: float | None = None,
108        poll_timeout: float | None = None,
109    ) -> Task:
110        """Poll a task until it reaches a terminal state and return it.
111
112        Use this to resume waiting for an upload started with
113        ``documents.upload(wait=False)``, or after a
114        :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError`.  A task that
115        paperless-ngx does not list yet (right after an upload) is polled
116        again rather than treated as missing.  The task is checked at least
117        once, even with ``poll_timeout=0``.  A status this library does not
118        know is treated as not finished yet.  An unknown ``task_id`` therefore
119        keeps being polled until ``poll_timeout`` and then raises
120        :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError`.
121
122        Args:
123            task_id: The task's UUID string, e.g. as returned by
124                ``documents.upload(wait=False)``.
125            poll_interval: Seconds between status checks.  When omitted, falls
126                back to the client-level ``poll_interval`` (``2.0`` s unless
127                changed at construction).
128            poll_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait.  When omitted, falls back to
129                the client-level ``poll_timeout`` (``60.0`` s unless changed at
130                construction).
131
132        Returns:
133            The final :class:`~easypaperless.models.tasks.Task` with status
134            ``SUCCESS``.
135
136        Raises:
137            ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError: If the task reports
138                ``FAILURE`` or ``REVOKED``; ``err.task`` holds the task with
139                paperless-ngx's ``status`` and ``result`` unaltered.
140            ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError: If the task does not
141                finish within ``poll_timeout`` seconds; ``err.task_id`` and
142                ``err.timeout`` are set so the caller can wait again.
143        """
144        interval = poll_interval if poll_interval is not None else self._core._poll_interval
145        timeout = poll_timeout if poll_timeout is not None else self._core._poll_timeout
146        logger.info("Waiting for task task_id=%r (timeout=%.1fs)", task_id, timeout)
147        start = time.monotonic()
148        deadline = start + timeout
149        while True:
150            task = await self._fetch(task_id)
151            elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
152            status = task.status if task is not None else None
153            logger.debug(
154                "Polling task %r (status=%s, elapsed=%.1fs)",
155                task_id,
156                status if status is not None else "unknown",
157                elapsed,
158            )
159            if task is not None and status == TaskStatus.SUCCESS:
160                logger.info("Task %r succeeded", task_id)
161                return task
162            if task is not None and status == TaskStatus.FAILURE:
163                logger.warning("Task %r failed: %s", task_id, task.result)
164                raise UploadError(f"Document processing failed: {task.result}", task=task)
165            if task is not None and status == TaskStatus.REVOKED:
166                logger.warning("Task %r was revoked", task_id)
167                raise UploadError(f"Task {task_id!r} was revoked", task=task)
168            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
169                break
170            await asyncio.sleep(interval)
171
172        logger.warning("Task %r timed out after %.1fs", task_id, time.monotonic() - start)
173        raise TaskTimeoutError(
174            f"Task {task_id!r} did not complete within {timeout}s",
175            task_id=task_id,
176            timeout=timeout,
177        )
178
179    async def acknowledge(self, ids: builtins.list[int]) -> int:
180        """Mark tasks as acknowledged, as the paperless-ngx UI's "Dismiss" does.
181
182        Args:
183            ids: Numeric task IDs (:attr:`Task.id
184                <easypaperless.models.tasks.Task.id>`, not the UUID
185                ``task_id``).
186
187        Returns:
188            The number of tasks paperless-ngx acknowledged.
189        """
190        logger.info("Acknowledging %d task(s)", len(ids))
191        resp = await self._core._session.post("/tasks/acknowledge/", json={"tasks": ids})
192        body = resp.json()
193        result = body.get("result") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
194        return result if isinstance(result, int) else len(ids)
195
196    async def _fetch(self, task_id: str) -> Task | None:
197        """Return the task with ``task_id``, or ``None`` if paperless has none."""
198        raw = await self._core._session.get_list(
199            "/tasks/", params={"task_id": task_id}, all_pages=False
200        )
201        if not raw.items:
202            return None
203        return Task.model_validate(raw.items[0])

Return background tasks, optionally filtered.

paperless-ngx returns the task list as a plain JSON array (not paginated); it is wrapped into a ~easypaperless.models.paged_result.PagedResult with next / previous set to None. A paginated response is accepted as well, and all its pages are fetched.

Arguments:
  • task_id: Only the task with this Celery task ID (UUID string).
  • status: Only tasks with this status, e.g. TaskStatus.FAILURE or "FAILURE".

async def wait( self, task_id: str, *, poll_interval: float | None = None, poll_timeout: float | None = None) -> easypaperless.Task: 
103    async def wait(
104        self,
105        task_id: str,
106        *,
107        poll_interval: float | None = None,
108        poll_timeout: float | None = None,
109    ) -> Task:
110        """Poll a task until it reaches a terminal state and return it.
111
112        Use this to resume waiting for an upload started with
113        ``documents.upload(wait=False)``, or after a
114        :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError`.  A task that
115        paperless-ngx does not list yet (right after an upload) is polled
116        again rather than treated as missing.  The task is checked at least
117        once, even with ``poll_timeout=0``.  A status this library does not
118        know is treated as not finished yet.  An unknown ``task_id`` therefore
119        keeps being polled until ``poll_timeout`` and then raises
120        :exc:`~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError`.
121
122        Args:
123            task_id: The task's UUID string, e.g. as returned by
124                ``documents.upload(wait=False)``.
125            poll_interval: Seconds between status checks.  When omitted, falls
126                back to the client-level ``poll_interval`` (``2.0`` s unless
127                changed at construction).
128            poll_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait.  When omitted, falls back to
129                the client-level ``poll_timeout`` (``60.0`` s unless changed at
130                construction).
131
132        Returns:
133            The final :class:`~easypaperless.models.tasks.Task` with status
134            ``SUCCESS``.
135
136        Raises:
137            ~easypaperless.exceptions.UploadError: If the task reports
138                ``FAILURE`` or ``REVOKED``; ``err.task`` holds the task with
139                paperless-ngx's ``status`` and ``result`` unaltered.
140            ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError: If the task does not
141                finish within ``poll_timeout`` seconds; ``err.task_id`` and
142                ``err.timeout`` are set so the caller can wait again.
143        """
144        interval = poll_interval if poll_interval is not None else self._core._poll_interval
145        timeout = poll_timeout if poll_timeout is not None else self._core._poll_timeout
146        logger.info("Waiting for task task_id=%r (timeout=%.1fs)", task_id, timeout)
147        start = time.monotonic()
148        deadline = start + timeout
149        while True:
150            task = await self._fetch(task_id)
151            elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
152            status = task.status if task is not None else None
153            logger.debug(
154                "Polling task %r (status=%s, elapsed=%.1fs)",
155                task_id,
156                status if status is not None else "unknown",
157                elapsed,
158            )
159            if task is not None and status == TaskStatus.SUCCESS:
160                logger.info("Task %r succeeded", task_id)
161                return task
162            if task is not None and status == TaskStatus.FAILURE:
163                logger.warning("Task %r failed: %s", task_id, task.result)
164                raise UploadError(f"Document processing failed: {task.result}", task=task)
165            if task is not None and status == TaskStatus.REVOKED:
166                logger.warning("Task %r was revoked", task_id)
167                raise UploadError(f"Task {task_id!r} was revoked", task=task)
168            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
169                break
170            await asyncio.sleep(interval)
171
172        logger.warning("Task %r timed out after %.1fs", task_id, time.monotonic() - start)
173        raise TaskTimeoutError(
174            f"Task {task_id!r} did not complete within {timeout}s",
175            task_id=task_id,
176            timeout=timeout,
177        )

A task that paperless-ngx does not list yet (right after an upload) is polled again rather than treated as missing. The task is checked at least once, even with poll_timeout=0. A status this library does not know is treated as not finished yet. An unknown task_id therefore keeps being polled until poll_timeout and then raises ~easypaperless.exceptions.TaskTimeoutError.

async def acknowledge(self, ids: list[int]) -> int: 
179    async def acknowledge(self, ids: builtins.list[int]) -> int:
180        """Mark tasks as acknowledged, as the paperless-ngx UI's "Dismiss" does.
181
182        Args:
183            ids: Numeric task IDs (:attr:`Task.id
184                <easypaperless.models.tasks.Task.id>`, not the UUID
185                ``task_id``).
186
187        Returns:
188            The number of tasks paperless-ngx acknowledged.
189        """
190        logger.info("Acknowledging %d task(s)", len(ids))
191        resp = await self._core._session.post("/tasks/acknowledge/", json={"tasks": ids})
192        body = resp.json()
193        result = body.get("result") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
194        return result if isinstance(result, int) else len(ids)
